    {cx=917.30,  cz=2392.60, hx=107.00/2, hz=28.00/2},
    {cx=830.30,  cz=2242.55, hx=58.00/2,  hz=34.10/2},
    {cx=748.90,  cz=2340.60, hx=59.40/2,  hz=109.20/2},
    {cx=799.10,  cz=2299.00, hx=14.00/2,  hz=33.99/2},
    {cx=826.69,  cz=2338.60, hx=51.19/2,  hz=12.00/2},
    {cx=799.65,  cz=2269.23, hx=12.90/2,  hz=21.50/2},
    {cx=765.36,  cz=2247.57, hx=59.32/2,  hz=64.82/2},
    {cx=850.20,  cz=2571.80, hx=23.20/2,  hz=13.60/2},
    {cx=779.80,  cz=2479.80, hx=164.00/2, hz=170.40/2},
    {cx=983.35,  cz=2315.15, hx=31.10/2,  hz=58.90/2},
    {cx=916.50,  cz=2225.40, hx=99.00/2,  hz=38.00/2},
    {cx=889.80,  cz=2361.60, hx=220.00/2, hz=34.00/2},
    {cx=915.80,  cz=2456.60, hx=64.00/2,  hz=100.00/2},
    {cx=820.80,  cz=2386.60, hx=82.00/2,  hz=16.00/2},
    {cx=916.90,  cz=2294.50, hx=98.20/2,  hz=100.20/2},
    {cx=836.95,  cz=2296.10, hx=61.70/2,  hz=73.00/2},
    {cx=872.30,  cz=2463.60, hx=19.00/2,  hz=62.00/2},
    {cx=959.30,  cz=2463.60, hx=19.00/2,  hz=62.00/2},
}
local prison = {cx=773.62, cz=2327.43, hx=563.37/2, hz=540.30/2}

local function inBox(x, z, r)
    return math.abs(x - r.cx) <= r.hx and math.abs(z - r.cz) <= r.hz
end

local function isInSubRegion(x, z)
    for _, r in ipairs(subRegions) do
        if inBox(x, z, r) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function safeEnable(conn)
    if conn and type(conn.Enable) == "function" then
        pcall(function() conn:Enable() end)
    end
end

local function safeDisable(conn)
    if conn and type(conn.Disconnect) == "function" then
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
end

local AntiNoclipCleared = false
local function ClearGlobalAntiNoclip()
    if AntiNoclipCleared then return end
    AntiNoclipCleared = true
    local scriptsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Scripts")
    if not scriptsFolder then return end
    local cc = scriptsFolder:FindFirstChild("CharacterCollision")
    if cc then cc:Destroy() end
end

local MaxSpeed = (function()
    local Enabled        = false
    local CharAddedConn  = nil
    local RegionThread   = nil
    local CurrentChar    = nil
    local StaminaConns   = {}

    local function restoreStamina()
        for _, c in ipairs(StaminaConns) do safeEnable(c) end
        StaminaConns = {}
    end

    local function bindStamina(humanoid)
        task.defer(function()
            if type(getconnections) ~= "function" then return end
            if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
            local ok, conns = pcall(getconnections, humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Jump"))
            if not ok or type(conns) ~= "table" then return end
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
                if c and type(c.Disable) == "function" then
                    pcall(function()
                        c:Disable()
                        StaminaConns[#StaminaConns + 1] = c
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function stopRegionLoop()
        if RegionThread then
            pcall(task.cancel, RegionThread)
            RegionThread = nil
        end
    end

    local function startCharacter(char)
        if not Enabled or not char or not char.Parent then return end
        stopRegionLoop()
        CurrentChar = char

        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            or char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        if not humanoid or not root then return end
        if not Enabled then return end

        local origJump = humanoid.JumpHeight
        bindStamina(humanoid)

        RegionThread = task.spawn(function()
            while Enabled
                and CurrentChar == char
                and char.Parent
                and humanoid.Parent
                and humanoid.Health > 0
            do
                task.wait()
                local x, z = root.Position.X, root.Position.Z
                if isInSubRegion(x, z) then
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed  = 32
                    humanoid.JumpHeight = origJump
                elseif inBox(x, z, prison) then
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed  = 50
                    humanoid.JumpHeight = 25
                else
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed  = 100
                    humanoid.JumpHeight = 50
                end
            end
            if RegionThread == coroutine.running() then
                RegionThread = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true
        ClearGlobalAntiNoclip()

        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            task.spawn(startCharacter, LocalPlayer.Character)
        end
        CharAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
            task.spawn(startCharacter, c)
        end)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        safeDisable(CharAddedConn)
        CharAddedConn = nil

        stopRegionLoop()
        restoreStamina()

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            local h = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if h then
                pcall(function()
                    h.WalkSpeed  = 16
                    h.JumpHeight = 7.2
                end)
            end
        end
        CurrentChar = nil
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

local Noclip = (function()
    local Enabled       = false
    local CharAddedConn = nil
    local SteppedConn   = nil
    local SavedCollide  = {}
    local HeadConns     = {}
    local BoundHeads    = {}

    local function strip(char)
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                if SavedCollide[d] == nil then
                    SavedCollide[d] = d.CanCollide
                end
                if d.CanCollide then
                    d.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function restoreCollide()
        for part, can in pairs(SavedCollide) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                pcall(function() part.CanCollide = can end)
            end
        end
        SavedCollide = {}
    end

    local function bindHead(head)
        if not head or BoundHeads[head] then return end
        BoundHeads[head] = true
        task.defer(function()
            if type(getconnections) ~= "function" then return end
            if not head or not head.Parent then return end
            local ok, conns = pcall(getconnections, head:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"))
            if not ok or type(conns) ~= "table" then return end
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
                if c and type(c.Disable) == "function" then
                    pcall(function()
                        c:Disable()
                        HeadConns[#HeadConns + 1] = c
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function restoreHeadConns()
        for _, c in ipairs(HeadConns) do safeEnable(c) end
        HeadConns = {}
        BoundHeads = {}
    end

    local function attachCharacter(char)
        if not Enabled or not char then return end
        ClearGlobalAntiNoclip()

        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if head then bindHead(head) end

        if char.Parent then strip(char) end
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true
        ClearGlobalAntiNoclip()

        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            task.spawn(attachCharacter, LocalPlayer.Character)
        end
        CharAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
            task.spawn(attachCharacter, c)
        end)

        SteppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not Enabled then return end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char and char.Parent then
                strip(char)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        safeDisable(CharAddedConn)
        CharAddedConn = nil
        safeDisable(SteppedConn)
        SteppedConn = nil

        restoreCollide()
        restoreHeadConns()
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

return {
    MaxSpeed = MaxSpeed,
    Noclip   = Noclip,
}
end)()

__bundle["AlwaysSprint"] = (function()
local AlwaysSprint = (function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")

    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local TARGET_SPEED  = 24
    local DEFAULT_SPEED = 16

    local Enabled = false

    local HumanoidConns = {}
    local CharAddedConn = nil

    local function clearConns()
        for _, c in ipairs(HumanoidConns) do
            pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
        end
        HumanoidConns = {}
    end

    local function lockWalkSpeed(character)
        if not Enabled or not character then return end

        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not humanoid or not Enabled then return end

        if humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= 0 then
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = TARGET_SPEED
        end

        local conn = humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
            if not Enabled then return end
            local current = humanoid.WalkSpeed
            if current ~= 0 and current ~= TARGET_SPEED then
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = TARGET_SPEED
            end
        end)

        HumanoidConns[#HumanoidConns + 1] = conn
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true

        clearConns()

        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            task.spawn(lockWalkSpeed, LocalPlayer.Character)
        end

        CharAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            clearConns()
            task.spawn(lockWalkSpeed, char)
        end)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        clearConns()

        if CharAddedConn then
            CharAddedConn:Disconnect()
            CharAddedConn = nil
        end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.WalkSpeed ~= 0 then
                pcall(function() hum.WalkSpeed = DEFAULT_SPEED end)
            end
        end
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

return { AlwaysSprint = AlwaysSprint }
end)()

__bundle["AutoArrest"] = (function()
local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService        = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Teams             = game:GetService("Teams")
local TweenService      = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local AutoArrest = (function()

    local COOLDOWN      = 7
    local ARREST_RANGE  = 7.5
    local LOOP_INTERVAL = 0.2

    local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        or ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)

    local ArrestRemote = Remotes and (
        Remotes:FindFirstChild("ArrestPlayer")
        or Remotes:WaitForChild("ArrestPlayer", 10)
    )

    if not ArrestRemote then
        return {
            Set = function() end,
            Get = function() return false end,
        }
    end

    local Enabled = false

    local Billboard, Holder, Label, BarBg, BarFill

    local Active         = false
    local LastArrestTime = 0
    local CooldownConn   = nil

    local MetaTable, OldNamecall = nil, nil
    local HookInstalled = false

    local CharAddedConn = nil

    local LoopActive = false

    local function createUI()
        if Billboard then return end

        local gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
        if not gui then return end

        Billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        Billboard.Name = "ParallaxArrestCooldown"
        Billboard.Adornee = nil
        Billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 40)
        Billboard.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
        Billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        Billboard.LightInfluence = 0
        Billboard.MaxDistance = 100
        Billboard.ResetOnSpawn = false
        Billboard.Parent = gui

        Holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        Holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        Holder.Parent = Billboard

        Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        Label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        Label.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)
        Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
        Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        Label.Text = string.format("%.2f", COOLDOWN)
        Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        Label.TextSize = 22
        Label.TextTransparency = 1
        Label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
        Label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        Label.Parent = Holder

        BarBg = Instance.new("Frame")
        BarBg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        BarBg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 30)
        BarBg.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 2)
        BarBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        BarBg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        BarBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
        BarBg.Parent = Holder

        BarFill = Instance.new("Frame")
        BarFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        BarFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        BarFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        BarFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        BarFill.Parent = BarBg
    end

    local function destroyUI()
        if CooldownConn then
            CooldownConn:Disconnect()
            CooldownConn = nil
        end
        if Billboard then
            Billboard:Destroy()
        end
        Billboard, Holder, Label, BarBg, BarFill = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
        Active = false
        LastArrestTime = 0
    end

    local function attachToCharacter(char)
        if not Billboard or not char then return end
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then
            root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        end
        if root and Billboard then
            Billboard.Adornee = root
            Billboard.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
        end
    end

    local function fade(toTransparency, duration)
        if not Label or not BarBg or not BarFill then return end
        local info = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        TweenService:Create(Label, info, {
            TextTransparency = toTransparency,
            TextStrokeTransparency = toTransparency + (1 - toTransparency) * 0.5,
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(BarFill, info, { BackgroundTransparency = toTransparency }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(BarBg, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.75 + (0.25 * toTransparency) }):Play()
    end

    local function startCooldown()
        if not Enabled or not Label then return end
        if Active then return end

        Active = true
        LastArrestTime = os.clock()

        local startTime = os.clock()
        Label.Text = string.format("%.2f", COOLDOWN)
        BarFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        fade(0, 0.15)

        if CooldownConn then CooldownConn:Disconnect() end
        CooldownConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not Enabled or not Label then
                if CooldownConn then CooldownConn:Disconnect() CooldownConn = nil end
                return
            end

            local remaining = math.max(COOLDOWN - (os.clock() - startTime), 0)
            Label.Text = string.format("%.2f", remaining)
            BarFill.Size = UDim2.new(remaining / COOLDOWN, 0, 1, 0)

            if remaining <= 0 then
                if CooldownConn then CooldownConn:Disconnect() CooldownConn = nil end
                fade(1, 0.35)
                task.delay(0.35, function()
                    if Enabled then Active = false end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function onCooldown()
        return Active or (os.clock() - LastArrestTime) < COOLDOWN
    end

    local function installHook()
        if HookInstalled then return end
        if type(getrawmetatable) ~= "function" then return end
        if type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then return end

        local ok, mt = pcall(getrawmetatable, game)
        if not ok or type(mt) ~= "table" then return end

        local old = mt.__namecall
        if type(old) ~= "function" then return end

        local function handler(self, ...)
            local method = getnamecallmethod()
            if method == "InvokeServer" and self == ArrestRemote then
                local result = old(self, ...)
                if result and Enabled then
                    task.spawn(startCooldown)
                end
                return result
            end
            return old(self, ...)
        end

        local wrapper = handler
        if type(newcclosure) == "function" then
            local okWrap, wrapped = pcall(newcclosure, handler)
            if okWrap and type(wrapped) == "function" then
                wrapper = wrapped
            end
        end

        local okApply = pcall(function()
            setreadonly(mt, false)
            mt.__namecall = wrapper
            setreadonly(mt, true)
        end)

        if okApply then
            MetaTable = mt
            OldNamecall = old
            HookInstalled = true
        end
    end

    local function uninstallHook()
        if not HookInstalled then return end
        if MetaTable and OldNamecall then
            pcall(function()
                setreadonly(MetaTable, false)
                MetaTable.__namecall = OldNamecall
                setreadonly(MetaTable, true)
            end)
        end
        HookInstalled = false
        MetaTable = nil
        OldNamecall = nil
    end

    local function isGuard()
        return player.Team ~= nil and player.Team.Name == "Guards"
    end

    local function isValidTarget(char)
        if not char then return false end

        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
        if char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return false end

        local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
        if not targetPlayer or targetPlayer == player then return false end

        local team = targetPlayer.Team
        if team == Teams:FindFirstChild("Criminals") then return true end

        if team == Teams:FindFirstChild("Inmates") then
            local attrs = char:GetAttributes()
            if attrs.Hostile and attrs.Tased then return true end
            if attrs.Trespassing then return true end
        end

        return false
    end

    local function getNearestTarget()
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return nil end

        local nearest, nearestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if other ~= player then
                local tChar = other.Character
                if tChar and isValidTarget(tChar) then
                    local tRoot = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if tRoot then
                        local dist = (root.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude
                        if dist <= ARREST_RANGE and dist < nearestDist then
                            nearestDist = dist
                            nearest = other
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nearest
    end

    local function attemptArrest(targetPlayer)
        if not ArrestRemote then return false end
        if onCooldown() then return false end
        if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then return false end
        if not isValidTarget(targetPlayer.Character) then return false end

        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return ArrestRemote:InvokeServer(targetPlayer, 1)
        end)

        if ok and result == true then

            task.spawn(startCooldown)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    local function startLoop()
        if LoopActive then return end
        LoopActive = true
        task.spawn(function()
            while Enabled and LoopActive do
                task.wait(LOOP_INTERVAL)
                if not Enabled then break end
                if isGuard() and not onCooldown() then
                    local target = getNearestTarget()
                    if target then
                        attemptArrest(target)
                    end
                end
            end
            LoopActive = false
        end)
    end

    local function stopLoop()
        LoopActive = false
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true

        createUI()
        installHook()

        if player.Character then
            task.spawn(attachToCharacter, player.Character)
        end
        CharAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            if Enabled then
                task.spawn(attachToCharacter, char)
            end
        end)

        startLoop()
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        if CharAddedConn then
            CharAddedConn:Disconnect()
            CharAddedConn = nil
        end

        stopLoop()
        uninstallHook()
        destroyUI()

        Active = false
        LastArrestTime = 0
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

return {
    AutoArrest = AutoArrest,
}
end)()

__bundle["TaseBypass"] = (function()
local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local TaseBypass = (function()
    local TASE_ANIMS = {
        ["rbxassetid://279227693"] = true,
        ["rbxassetid://279229192"] = true,
    }

    local DEFAULT_SPEED = 16
    local DEFAULT_JUMP  = 7.2

    local Enabled = false

    local humanoid  = nil
    local lastSpeed = DEFAULT_SPEED
    local lastJump  = DEFAULT_JUMP

    local eventConns    = {}
    local humanoidConns = {}
    local charAddedConn = nil

    local PlayerTased = nil
    do
        local GunRemotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GunRemotes")
        if GunRemotes then
            PlayerTased = GunRemotes:FindFirstChild("PlayerTased")
        end
    end

    local function clearTable(t)
        for _, c in ipairs(t) do
            if c and type(c.Disconnect) == "function" then
                pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(t)
    end

    local function enableBackpack()
        if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("BackpackEnabled") ~= true then
            LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("BackpackEnabled", true)
        end
    end

    local function setupCharacter(character)
        if not character or not Enabled then return end

        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not hum then return end
        if not Enabled then return end

        humanoid = hum

        if hum.WalkSpeed > 0 then lastSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed end
        if hum.JumpHeight > 0 then lastJump  = hum.JumpHeight end

        clearTable(humanoidConns)

        humanoidConns[#humanoidConns + 1] =
            hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
                if hum.WalkSpeed > 0 then lastSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed end
            end)

        humanoidConns[#humanoidConns + 1] =
            hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("JumpHeight"):Connect(function()
                if hum.JumpHeight > 0 then lastJump = hum.JumpHeight end
            end)
    end

    local function fixTase()
        if not Enabled then return end
        local hum = humanoid
        if not hum or not hum.Parent or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

        if hum.WalkSpeed == 0 and hum.JumpHeight == 0 then
            hum.WalkSpeed  = lastSpeed
            hum.JumpHeight = lastJump
        end

        for _, track in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            local anim = track.Animation
            if anim and TASE_ANIMS[anim.AnimationId] then
                track:Stop(0)
            end
        end

        enableBackpack()
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true

        humanoid  = nil
        lastSpeed = DEFAULT_SPEED
        lastJump  = DEFAULT_JUMP
        clearTable(humanoidConns)

        if PlayerTased then
            eventConns[#eventConns + 1] = PlayerTased.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                task.defer(fixTase)
            end)
        end

        eventConns[#eventConns + 1] =
            LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BackpackEnabled"):Connect(function()
                if Enabled and LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("BackpackEnabled") ~= true then
                    enableBackpack()
                end
            end)

        charAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
            humanoid = nil
            task.spawn(function()
                setupCharacter(c)
                enableBackpack()
            end)
        end)

        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            task.spawn(function()
                setupCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
                enableBackpack()
            end)
        end
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        clearTable(eventConns)
        clearTable(humanoidConns)

        if charAddedConn then
            charAddedConn:Disconnect()
            charAddedConn = nil
        end

        humanoid = nil
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

return {
    TaseBypass = TaseBypass,
}
end)()

__bundle["GunMods"] = (function()
local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local GunMods = (function()
    local FIRE_RATE_MAX_SPS = 30

    local Enabled       = false
    local ShotsPerSec   = 15
    local NoSpread      = false
    local AutoFire      = false

    local gunBaseStats = {}

    local heartbeatConn = nil
    local charAddedConn = nil
    local charChildConn = nil
    local bpChildConn   = nil

    local function isGun(tool)
        return tool and tool:IsA("Tool")
            and tool:GetAttribute("ToolType") == "Gun"
    end

    local function clampConfig()
        ShotsPerSec = math.clamp(tonumber(ShotsPerSec) or 15, 1, FIRE_RATE_MAX_SPS)
    end

    local function storeBaseStats(tool)
        if gunBaseStats[tool] then return end
        gunBaseStats[tool] = {
            FireRate     = tool:GetAttribute("FireRate"),
            SpreadRadius = tool:GetAttribute("SpreadRadius"),
            AutoFire     = tool:GetAttribute("AutoFire"),
        }
    end

    local function applyGun(tool)
        if not Enabled then return end
        if not isGun(tool) then return end

        clampConfig()
        storeBaseStats(tool)

        local desiredFireRate = 1 / ShotsPerSec
        if tool:GetAttribute("FireRate") ~= desiredFireRate then
            tool:SetAttribute("FireRate", desiredFireRate)
        end

        if NoSpread then
            if tool:GetAttribute("SpreadRadius") ~= 0 then
                tool:SetAttribute("SpreadRadius", 0)
            end
        else
            local base = gunBaseStats[tool]
            if base and base.SpreadRadius ~= nil
                and tool:GetAttribute("SpreadRadius") ~= base.SpreadRadius then
                tool:SetAttribute("SpreadRadius", base.SpreadRadius)
            end
        end

        if AutoFire then
            if tool:GetAttribute("AutoFire") ~= true then
                tool:SetAttribute("AutoFire", true)
            end
        else
            local base = gunBaseStats[tool]
            if base and base.AutoFire ~= nil
                and tool:GetAttribute("AutoFire") ~= base.AutoFire then
                tool:SetAttribute("AutoFire", base.AutoFire)
            end
        end
    end

    local function restoreGun(tool)
        local base = gunBaseStats[tool]
        if not base then return end

        if base.FireRate     ~= nil then tool:SetAttribute("FireRate",     base.FireRate)     end
        if base.SpreadRadius ~= nil then tool:SetAttribute("SpreadRadius", base.SpreadRadius) end
        if base.AutoFire     ~= nil then tool:SetAttribute("AutoFire",     base.AutoFire)     end

        gunBaseStats[tool] = nil
    end

    local function eachGun(fn)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if isGun(t) then fn(t) end
            end
        end
        local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if bp then
            for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if isGun(t) then fn(t) end
            end
        end
    end

    local function applyToAllGuns()
        if not Enabled then return end
        eachGun(applyGun)
    end

    local function restoreAllGuns()
        eachGun(restoreGun)
        table.clear(gunBaseStats)
    end

    local function heartbeatTick()
        if not Enabled then return end
        eachGun(function(tool)
            storeBaseStats(tool)
            applyGun(tool)
        end)
    end

    local function startLoop()
        if heartbeatConn then return end
        heartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(heartbeatTick)
    end

    local function stopLoop()
        if heartbeatConn then
            heartbeatConn:Disconnect()
            heartbeatConn = nil
        end
    end

    local function onToolAdded(tool)
        if not isGun(tool) then return end
        task.wait(0.1)
        if Enabled then applyGun(tool) end
    end

    local function bindCharacter(char)
        if not char then return end
        if charChildConn then charChildConn:Disconnect() end
        charChildConn = char.ChildAdded:Connect(onToolAdded)
        task.wait(0.25)
        if Enabled then applyToAllGuns() end
    end

    local function bindBackpack()
        if bpChildConn then bpChildConn:Disconnect() end
        local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if bp then
            bpChildConn = bp.ChildAdded:Connect(onToolAdded)
        end
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true

        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            task.spawn(bindCharacter, LocalPlayer.Character)
        end
        bindBackpack()

        charAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
            bindBackpack()
            bindCharacter(c)
        end)

        startLoop()
        task.spawn(applyToAllGuns)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        stopLoop()

        if charAddedConn then charAddedConn:Disconnect() charAddedConn = nil end
        if charChildConn then charChildConn:Disconnect() charChildConn = nil end
        if bpChildConn   then bpChildConn:Disconnect()   bpChildConn   = nil end

        restoreAllGuns()
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,

        SetShotsPerSec = function(v)
            ShotsPerSec = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or ShotsPerSec, 1, FIRE_RATE_MAX_SPS)
            if Enabled then applyToAllGuns() end
        end,

        SetNoSpread = function(v)
            NoSpread = v == true
            if Enabled then applyToAllGuns() end
        end,
        SetAutoFire = function(v)
            AutoFire = v == true
            if Enabled then applyToAllGuns() end
        end,
    }
end)()

return {
    GunMods = GunMods,
}
end)()

__bundle["AutoHeal"] = (function()
local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local AutoHeal = (function()
    local CONFIG = {
        HealthThreshold = 85,
        Cooldown        = 3,
        Interval        = 0.05,
        HealItems       = {
            Breakfast = true,
            Lunch     = true,
            Dinner    = true,
        },
    }

    local Enabled    = false
    local LoopActive = false

    local Remotes  = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local EatFood  = Remotes and Remotes:FindFirstChild("EatFood")

    local function ensureRemote()
        if EatFood and EatFood.Parent then return EatFood end
        if not Remotes then
            Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        end
        if Remotes then
            EatFood = Remotes:FindFirstChild("EatFood")
        end
        return EatFood
    end

    local function tryHeal()
        local remote = ensureRemote()
        if not remote then return end

        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then return end

        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        if humanoid.Health > CONFIG.HealthThreshold then return end

        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if not backpack then return end

        local healTool
        for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if tool:IsA("Tool") and CONFIG.HealItems[tool.Name] then
                healTool = tool
                break
            end
        end
        if not healTool then return end

        local quantity = healTool:GetAttribute("Quantity")
        local lastConsumed = healTool:GetAttribute("Client_LastConsumedAt") or 0

        if quantity ~= nil and quantity <= 0 then return end
        if (os.clock() - lastConsumed) < CONFIG.Cooldown then return end

        local lastEquipped = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")

        pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(healTool) end)
        if quantity ~= nil then
            pcall(function() healTool:SetAttribute("Quantity", quantity - 1) end)
        end
        pcall(function() healTool:SetAttribute("Client_LastConsumedAt", os.clock()) end)
        pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)

        task.wait(0.05)
        if not Enabled then return end
        if lastEquipped and lastEquipped.Parent then
            pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(lastEquipped) end)
        else
            pcall(function() humanoid:UnequipTools() end)
        end
    end

    local function startLoop()
        if LoopActive then return end
        LoopActive = true
        task.spawn(function()
            while Enabled and LoopActive do
                pcall(tryHeal)
                task.wait(CONFIG.Interval)
            end
            LoopActive = false
        end)
    end

    local function stopLoop()
        LoopActive = false
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true
        startLoop()
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false
        stopLoop()
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

return {
    AutoHeal = AutoHeal,
}
end)()

__bundle["CarSpawner"] = (function()
local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace         = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local CarSpawner = (function()
    local busy = false

    local function getInteract()
        local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        return Remotes and Remotes:FindFirstChild("InteractWithItem")
    end

    local function awaitInteract(timeout)
        local t0 = tick()
        local interact = getInteract()
        while not interact and (tick() - t0) < (timeout or 3) do
            task.wait(0.1)
            interact = getInteract()
        end
        return interact
    end

    local function spawn()
        if busy then return false end
        busy = true

        local ok = pcall(function()
            local interact = awaitInteract(3)
            if not interact then error("InteractWithItem not found") end

            local character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
            local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
            if not hrp then error("HumanoidRootPart missing") end

            local prisonItems = Workspace:WaitForChild("Prison_ITEMS", 5)
            local buttons = prisonItems and prisonItems:FindFirstChild("buttons")
            local carContainer = Workspace:WaitForChild("CarContainer", 5)
            if not buttons or not carContainer then
                error("world objects not ready")
            end

            local closestPart
            local closestDist = math.huge
            for _, model in ipairs(buttons:GetChildren()) do
                if model.Name == "Car Spawner" then
                    local part = model:FindFirstChild("Car Spawner")
                    if part then
                        local d = (hrp.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
                        if d < closestDist then
                            closestDist = d
                            closestPart = part
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not closestPart then error("no spawner found") end

            local existing = {}
            for _, car in ipairs(carContainer:GetChildren()) do
                existing[car] = true
            end

            hrp.CFrame = closestPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
            task.wait(0.15)
            interact:InvokeServer(closestPart)

            local newCar
            local timeout = tick() + 5
            repeat
                for _, car in ipairs(carContainer:GetChildren()) do
                    if not existing[car] then
                        newCar = car
                        break
                    end
                end
                task.wait()
            until newCar or tick() > timeout

            if newCar then
                local seat = newCar:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
                if seat then
                    hrp.CFrame = seat.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                end
            end
        end)

        busy = false
        return ok
    end

    return {
        Spawn = spawn,
    }
end)()

return {
    CarSpawner = CarSpawner,
}
end)()

__bundle["AntiFling"] = (function()
local AntiFling = (function()
    local Enabled    = false
    local Container  = nil
    local Conn       = nil
    local Original   = {}

    local function captureAndDisable(part)
        if not Enabled then return end
        if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end

        if Original[part] == nil then
            Original[part] = {
                CanCollide = part.CanCollide,
                CanTouch   = part.CanTouch,
                CanQuery   = part.CanQuery,
            }
        end

        pcall(function()
            part.CanCollide = false
            part.CanTouch   = false
            part.CanQuery   = false
        end)
    end

    local function restoreAll()
        for part, stats in pairs(Original) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    part.CanCollide = stats.CanCollide
                    part.CanTouch   = stats.CanTouch
                    part.CanQuery   = stats.CanQuery
                end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(Original)
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end

        local cc = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
            or workspace:WaitForChild("CarContainer", 3)
        if not cc then return end

        Enabled   = true
        Container = cc

        for _, part in ipairs(Container:GetDescendants()) do
            captureAndDisable(part)
        end

        Conn = Container.DescendantAdded:Connect(captureAndDisable)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        if Conn then
            Conn:Disconnect()
            Conn = nil
        end

        restoreAll()
        Container = nil
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

return {
    AntiFling = AntiFling,
}
end)()

__bundle["SilentAim"] = (function()
local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace         = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService  = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Teams             = game:GetService("Teams")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Enabled     = false
local HitChance   = 85
local WORLD_RANGE = 500
local FOV_PIXELS  = 250
local AIM_PART    = "Head"
local WALLS       = true
local SKIP_DOWNED = true

local pl              = {}
local oldBulletHook   = nil
local castRayParams   = nil

local function isVector3(v) return typeof(v) == "Vector3" end

local function safeUpvalue(fn, idx)
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local ok, v = pcall(debug.getupvalue, fn, idx)
    return ok and v or nil
end

local function getShootFunction()
    if pl.Bullet and pl.Shoot then return true end

    local gui = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Home")
    gui = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("hud")
    gui = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("ActionArea")
    if gui then
        for _, connection in ipairs(getconnections(gui.InputBegan)) do
            local fn = connection.Function
            if fn then
                local shoot = safeUpvalue(fn, 2)
                if type(shoot) == "function" then
                    local bullet = safeUpvalue(shoot, 16)
                    if type(bullet) == "function" then
                        pl.Shoot     = shoot
                        pl.Reload    = safeUpvalue(shoot, 2)
                        pl.Bullet    = bullet
                        pl.GunData   = safeUpvalue(shoot, 10)
                        if type(pl.Reload) == "function" then
                            pl.PlaySound = safeUpvalue(pl.Reload, 3)
                        end

                        local params = safeUpvalue(bullet, 2)
                        if typeof(params) == "RaycastParams" then
                            castRayParams = params
                        end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, connection in ipairs(getconnections(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded)) do
        local fn = connection.Function
        if fn then
            local src = debug.info(fn, "s")
            if src and src:find("GunController") then
                local params = safeUpvalue(fn, 2)
                if typeof(params) == "RaycastParams" and not castRayParams then
                    castRayParams = params
                end

                local onEquipped = safeUpvalue(fn, 3)
                if type(onEquipped) == "function" then
                    pl.OnEquipped = onEquipped
                    local canBeDamaged = safeUpvalue(onEquipped, 20)
                    if type(canBeDamaged) == "function" then
                        pl.CanBeDamaged = canBeDamaged
                    end
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end

    return pl.Bullet ~= nil
end

local rand = Random.new()

local function getMousePosition()
    if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        return Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize / 2
    end
    return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
end

local function isDowned(char)
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return true end
    local state = hum:GetState()
    return state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
        or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
end

local function getAimPart(char)
    if AIM_PART and AIM_PART ~= "Auto" then
        local p = char:FindFirstChild(AIM_PART)
        if p then return p end
    end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function fallbackCanBeDamaged(plr)
    if plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team then
        return false
    end
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return false end

    local isTaser = pl.GunData and pl.GunData.Behavior == "Taser"

    if not isTaser
        and Teams.Guards and Teams.Inmates
        and LocalPlayer.Team == Teams.Guards
        and plr.Team == Teams.Inmates
        and not char:GetAttribute("Hostile")
    then
        return false
    end

    if not isTaser
        and Teams.Criminals and Teams.Inmates
        and LocalPlayer.Team == Teams.Criminals
        and plr.Team == Teams.Inmates
        and not char:GetAttribute("Hostile")
    then
        return false
    end

    if char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField") then return false end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end

    return true
end

local function getTarget(origin)
    if rand:NextNumber(0, 100) > HitChance then return end

    local camera   = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local mousePos = getMousePosition()
    local candidates = {}

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LocalPlayer then continue end

        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then continue end

        if Teams.Criminals and Teams.Inmates
            and LocalPlayer.Team == Teams.Criminals
            and plr.Team == Teams.Inmates
            and not char:GetAttribute("Hostile")
        then
            continue
        end

        local allowed
        if pl.CanBeDamaged then
            local ok, res = pcall(pl.CanBeDamaged, plr)
            allowed = ok and res
        else
            allowed = fallbackCanBeDamaged(plr)
        end
        if not allowed then continue end

        if SKIP_DOWNED and isDowned(char) then continue end

        local part = getAimPart(char)
        if not part then continue end

        local dist = (
            (part.Position * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)) -
            (origin       * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1))
        ).magnitude
        if dist > WORLD_RANGE then continue end

        local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen then continue end

        local score = (mousePos - Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)).Magnitude
        if score > FOV_PIXELS then continue end

        candidates[#candidates + 1] = {
            Player = plr,
            Char   = char,
            Part   = part,
            Score  = score,
        }
    end

    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b) return a.Score < b.Score end)

    for _, c in ipairs(candidates) do
        if WALLS and castRayParams then
            local ray = Workspace:Raycast(
                origin,
                c.Part.Position - origin,
                castRayParams
            )
            if ray and not ray.Instance:IsDescendantOf(c.Char) then
                continue
            end
        end
        return c
    end
end

local function Hook(...)
    local args   = table.pack(...)
    local origin = args[1]

    if not isVector3(origin) then
        return oldBulletHook(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
    end

    local target = getTarget(origin)
    if not target then
        return oldBulletHook(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
    end

    args[2] = target.Part.Position

    if type(args[3]) == "number" then
        args[3] = 0
    end

    return oldBulletHook(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
end

local SilentAim = {}
SilentAim._pending = false

function SilentAim.Set(state)
    if state then
        if not pl.Bullet and not getShootFunction() then
            SilentAim._pending = true
            return false
        end
        Enabled = true
        SilentAim._pending = false

        if not oldBulletHook then
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                oldBulletHook = hookfunction(pl.Bullet, Hook)
            end)
            if not ok or not oldBulletHook then
                warn("[SilentAim] hook failed: " .. tostring(err))
                Enabled = false
                return false
            end
        end
    else
        Enabled = false
        SilentAim._pending = false
        if oldBulletHook then
            pcall(function()
                if restorefunction then
                    restorefunction(pl.Bullet)
                else
                    hookfunction(pl.Bullet, oldBulletHook)
                end
            end)
            oldBulletHook = nil
        end
    end
    return Enabled
end

function SilentAim.Get() return Enabled end

function SilentAim.SetHitChance(v)
    HitChance = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or HitChance, 0, 100)
end

function SilentAim.SetRange(world, fov)
    if world then WORLD_RANGE = math.max(1, tonumber(world) or WORLD_RANGE) end
    if fov   then FOV_PIXELS  = math.max(1, tonumber(fov)   or FOV_PIXELS)  end
end

function SilentAim.SetWalls(v) WALLS = not not v end
function SilentAim.SetAimPart(name)
    if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then AIM_PART = name end
end
function SilentAim.SetSkipDowned(v) SKIP_DOWNED = not not v end

task.spawn(function()
    local attempts = 0
    while not getShootFunction() and attempts < 100 do
        task.wait(0.1)
        attempts += 1
    end

    if pl.Bullet then
        print("Resolved")
        if SilentAim._pending then
            SilentAim.Set(true)
        end
    else
        warn("Failed")
    end
end)

local FastSwitch = (function()
    local Enabled  = false
    local Delay    = 0.05
    local Thread   = nil
    local GunNames = nil

    local function loadGunNames()
        if GunNames and next(GunNames) ~= nil then return GunNames end
        local names = {}
        local tools = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Tools")
        local gunsFolder = tools and tools:FindFirstChild("Guns")
        if gunsFolder then
            for _, gun in ipairs(gunsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                names[gun.Name] = true
            end
        end
        if next(names) ~= nil then GunNames = names end
        return names
    end

    local function isUsableGun(tool)
        if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
        if tool.Name == "Taser" then return false end
        local names = loadGunNames()
        if next(names) == nil then return true end
        return names[tool.Name] == true
    end

    local function loop()
        local index = 0
        while Enabled do
            task.wait(Delay)
            if not Enabled then break end

            local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            if backpack then
                local list = {}
                for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
                    if isUsableGun(tool) then
                        list[#list + 1] = tool
                    end
                end

                if #list > 0 then
                    index = (index % #list) + 1
                    local tool = list[index]
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum and hum.Health > 0 then

                        if char:FindFirstChild(tool.Name) ~= tool then
                            pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        Thread = nil
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true
        if not Thread then
            Thread = task.spawn(loop)
        end
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
        SetDelay = function(v)
            Delay = math.max(0.01, tonumber(v) or Delay)
        end,
    }
end)()

return {
    SilentAim  = SilentAim,
    FastSwitch = FastSwitch,
}
end)()

__bundle["AimAssist"] = (function()
local AimAssist = (function()
    local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local Workspace        = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local Teams            = game:GetService("Teams")

    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    local IS_MOBILE   = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled

    local CONFIG = {
        MaxRange           = 400,
        MobileBoost        = 1.6,
        RequireLineOfSight = true,
        IgnoreTeammates    = true,
        CheckForceField    = true,
        PredictMovement    = true,
        PredictionLead     = 0.045,
        StickyTime         = 0.35,
        AimParts           = { "Head", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" },
        PartFalloffPenalty = 12,
        RenderKey          = "ParallaxAimAssist",
    }

    local Enabled        = false
    local FOV            = 22
    local Responsiveness = 14

    local currentTarget, currentTargetPart
    local lockedModel, lockedAt = nil, 0

    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.CollisionGroup = "ClientBullet"
    raycastParams.FilterType     = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.IgnoreWater    = true

    local CharAddedConn
    local CameraChangedConn

    local function refreshFilter()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = char and { char } or {}
    end

    local function getAimParts(character)
        local parts = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(CONFIG.AimParts) do
            local p = character:FindFirstChild(name)
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
                parts[#parts + 1] = p
            end
        end
        return parts
    end

    local function raycastFromCamera(origin, targetPos)
        local dir = targetPos - origin
        local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, raycastParams)
        if not result then
            return true, targetPos
        end
        if result.Distance + 0.75 >= dir.Magnitude then
            return true, result.Position
        end
        return false, nil
    end

    local function isDamagable(player)
        if player == LocalPlayer then return false end

        if CONFIG.IgnoreTeammates and player.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
            return false
        end

        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return false end

        if LocalPlayer.Team == Teams.Guards
            and player.Team == Teams.Inmates
            and not char:GetAttribute("Hostile") then
            return false
        end

        if LocalPlayer.Team == Teams.Criminals
            and player.Team == Teams.Inmates
            and not char:GetAttribute("Hostile") then
            return false
        end

        if CONFIG.CheckForceField and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
            return false
        end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end

        return true
    end

    local function findBestTarget()
        if not camera then return nil end

        local camCF       = camera.CFrame
        local origin      = camCF.Position
        local look        = camCF.LookVector
        local maxAngleCos = math.cos(math.rad(FOV))

        local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge

        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if not isDamagable(player) then continue end

            local char = player.Character
            local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local velocity = (CONFIG.PredictMovement and hrp)
                and hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero

            for _, part in ipairs(getAimParts(char)) do
                local aimPos = part.Position
                if CONFIG.PredictMovement then
                    aimPos = aimPos + velocity * CONFIG.PredictionLead
                end

                local delta = aimPos - origin
                local dist  = delta.Magnitude
                if dist < 1 or dist > CONFIG.MaxRange then continue end

                local dot = look:Dot(delta / dist)
                if dot < maxAngleCos then continue end

                local ok = raycastFromCamera(origin, aimPos)
                if not ok then continue end

                local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(dot, -1, 1))

                local score = angle * 200
                            + dist * 0.05
                            + (part.Name ~= "Head" and CONFIG.PartFalloffPenalty or 0)

                if score < bestScore then
                    bestScore = score
                    best = {
                        player = player,
                        part   = part,
                        pos    = aimPos,
                    }
                end
            end
        end

        return best
    end

    local function isLockValid()
        if not lockedModel or not lockedModel.Parent then return false end
        local hum = lockedModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return hum and hum.Health > 0
    end

    local function selectTarget(candidate, now)
        if not candidate then
            if (now - lockedAt) > CONFIG.StickyTime then
                lockedModel, currentTarget, currentTargetPart = nil, nil, nil
            end
            return
        end

        local sameAsLocked = lockedModel and candidate.player.Character == lockedModel

        if sameAsLocked then
            currentTarget     = candidate
            currentTargetPart = candidate.part
            lockedAt          = now
            return
        end

        if isLockValid() and (now - lockedAt) < CONFIG.StickyTime then
            return
        end

        currentTarget     = candidate
        currentTargetPart = candidate.part
        lockedModel       = candidate.player.Character
        lockedAt          = now
    end

    local function onRenderStep(dt)
        if not Enabled or not camera then
            lockedModel, currentTarget, currentTargetPart = nil, nil, nil
            return
        end
        if camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
            lockedModel, currentTarget = nil, nil
            return
        end

        local now = os.clock()
        selectTarget(findBestTarget(), now)

        if not currentTarget then return end

        local char = currentTarget.player.Character
        if not char then return end

        local part = char:FindFirstChild(currentTargetPart and currentTargetPart.Name or "Head")
        if not part then
            for _, p in ipairs(getAimParts(char)) do part = p; break end
        end
        if not part then return end
        currentTargetPart = part

        local aimPos = part.Position
        if CONFIG.PredictMovement then
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                aimPos = aimPos + hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity * CONFIG.PredictionLead
            end
        end

        local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
        local delta  = aimPos - origin
        if delta.Magnitude < 1 then return end

        local resp  = Responsiveness * (IS_MOBILE and CONFIG.MobileBoost or 1)
        local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-resp * dt)

        local desired = CFrame.lookAt(origin, aimPos)
        camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(desired, alpha)
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true

        camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        refreshFilter()

        CameraChangedConn = Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
            camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        end)

        CharAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.wait(0.1)
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
        end)

        RunService:BindToRenderStep(
            CONFIG.RenderKey,
            Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1,
            onRenderStep
        )
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        pcall(function()
            RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CONFIG.RenderKey)
        end)

        if CameraChangedConn then
            CameraChangedConn:Disconnect()
            CameraChangedConn = nil
        end
        if CharAddedConn then
            CharAddedConn:Disconnect()
            CharAddedConn = nil
        end

        currentTarget, currentTargetPart = nil, nil
        lockedModel, lockedAt            = nil, 0
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,

        SetFOV = function(v)
            FOV = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or FOV, 1, 90)
        end,
        SetResponsiveness = function(v)
            Responsiveness = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or Responsiveness, 1, 50)
        end,
    }
end)()

return { AimAssist = AimAssist }
end)()

__bundle["Triggerbot"] = (function()
local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService  = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace         = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Triggerbot = (function()
    if type(getconnections) ~= "function" then
        return { Set = function() end, Get = function() return false end, SetFOV = function() end, SetRange = function() end }
    end
    if type(debug) ~= "table" or type(debug.getupvalue) ~= "function" then
        return { Set = function() end, Get = function() return false end, SetFOV = function() end, SetRange = function() end }
    end

    local RANGE_LIMIT    = 1500
    local MANUAL_RANGE   = 0
    local LOOP_DELAY     = 0.05
    local TARGET_PLAYERS = true
    local TARGET_NPCS    = false
    local FOV_RADIUS     = 250

    local Enabled       = false
    local Thread        = nil
    local LoopId        = 0
    local CharAddedConn = nil
    local ReloadFired   = false

    local Pl = {
        Shoot  = nil,
        Reload = nil,
        Tool   = nil,
        Data   = nil,
    }

    local Ring = {
        Screen = nil,
        Frame  = nil,
        Stroke = nil,
    }

    local function buildRing()
        if Ring.Screen and Ring.Screen.Parent then return end

        local gui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not gui then return end

        local orphan = gui:FindFirstChild("ParallaxFovRing")
        if orphan then orphan:Destroy() end

        local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        screen.Name = "ParallaxFovRing"
        screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
        screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        screen.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        screen.DisplayOrder = 1000
        screen.Enabled = false

        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Name = "Ring"
        frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(FOV_RADIUS * 2, FOV_RADIUS * 2)
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame.Parent = screen

        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        corner.Parent = frame

        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Thickness = 1.5
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        stroke.Transparency = 0.25
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Parent = frame

        screen.Parent = gui

        Ring.Screen = screen
        Ring.Frame  = frame
        Ring.Stroke = stroke
    end

    local function updateRing()
        if not Ring.Frame then return end
        Ring.Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(FOV_RADIUS * 2, FOV_RADIUS * 2)
    end

    local function setRingVisible(visible)
        if not Ring.Screen then return end
        Ring.Screen.Enabled = visible == true
    end

    local function refreshShootCache()
        local gui = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Home")
        gui = gui and gui.hud and gui.hud:FindFirstChild("ActionArea")
        if not gui then return false end

        local ok = pcall(function()
            for _, connection in getconnections(gui.InputBegan) do
                if connection.Function then
                    local shoot = debug.getupvalue(connection.Function, 2)
                    if type(shoot) == "function" then
                        local tool   = debug.getupvalue(shoot, 1)
                        local reload = debug.getupvalue(shoot, 2)
                        local data   = debug.getupvalue(shoot, 10)

                        Pl.Shoot  = shoot
                        Pl.Tool   = tool
                        Pl.Reload = (type(reload) == "function") and reload or nil
                        Pl.Data   = (type(data)   == "table")    and data   or nil
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        return ok and Pl.Shoot ~= nil
    end

    local function teamName(plr)
        local t = plr and plr.Team
        return t and string.lower(t.Name) or ""
    end

    local function hasHostileFlag(char)
        if char:GetAttribute("Hostile") == true then return true end
        if char:FindFirstChild("Hostile") then return true end
        return false
    end

    local function isShootable(candidateChar)
        if not candidateChar or not candidateChar.Parent then return false end

        local hum = candidateChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
        if hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then return false end

        if candidateChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField") then return false end

        local myTeam = teamName(LocalPlayer)
        local plr    = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(candidateChar)

        if plr then
            if plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
            local theirTeam = teamName(plr)

            if myTeam == "guards" then
                if theirTeam == "criminals" then return true end
                if hasHostileFlag(candidateChar) then return true end
                return false

            elseif myTeam == "inmates" then
                if theirTeam == "inmates" then return false end
                return true

            else
                if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
                    return false
                end
                return true
            end
        end

        if myTeam == "guards" then
            return hasHostileFlag(candidateChar)
        end
        return true
    end

    local function getAimPoint()
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return 0, 0 end
        return cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2
    end

    local function projectToScreen(part)
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return nil, false end

        local pos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen then return nil, false end

        if (part.Position - cam.CFrame.Position):Dot(cam.CFrame.LookVector) <= 0 then
            return nil, false
        end

        local vp = cam.ViewportSize
        if pos.X < 0 or pos.Y < 0 or pos.X > vp.X or pos.Y > vp.Y then
            return nil, false
        end

        return pos, true
    end

    local function hasLineOfSight(targetChar)
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not myChar then return false end
        local myHead = myChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not myHead or not myHead:IsA("BasePart") then return false end

        local targetHead = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not targetHead or not targetHead:IsA("BasePart") then return false end

        local dir = targetHead.Position - myHead.Position
        if dir.Magnitude <= 0 then return false end

        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { myChar, targetChar }

        pcall(function() params.CollisionGroup = "ClientBullet" end)

        local hit = Workspace:Raycast(myHead.Position, dir, params)
        return hit == nil
    end

    local function considerTarget(candidateChar, aimX, aimY, myHead, best)
        if not candidateChar then return best end
        if not isShootable(candidateChar) then return best end

        local head = candidateChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head or not head:IsA("BasePart") then return best end

        local delta = head.Position - myHead.Position
        local rangeFromMe = delta.Magnitude
        if rangeFromMe <= 0 then return best end

        local maxRange
        if MANUAL_RANGE and MANUAL_RANGE > 0 then
            maxRange = MANUAL_RANGE
        else
            maxRange = (Pl.Data and Pl.Data.Range) or RANGE_LIMIT
        end
        if rangeFromMe > maxRange then return best end

        local screenPos, onScreen = projectToScreen(head)
        if not onScreen then return best end

        local dx = screenPos.X - aimX
        local dy = screenPos.Y - aimY
        local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

        if dist > FOV_RADIUS then return best end
        if dist >= best.dist then return best end

        if not hasLineOfSight(candidateChar) then return best end

        best.char = candidateChar
        best.dist = dist
        return best
    end

    local function getTarget()
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not myChar then return nil end
        local myHead = myChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not myHead then return nil end

        local currentTool = myChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
        if not currentTool or currentTool ~= Pl.Tool then
            if not refreshShootCache() then return nil end
            currentTool = Pl.Tool
        end

        if not Pl.Data then return nil end

        local aimX, aimY = getAimPoint()
        local best = { char = nil, dist = FOV_RADIUS }

        if TARGET_PLAYERS then
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                    best = considerTarget(plr.Character, aimX, aimY, myHead, best)
                end
            end
        end

        if TARGET_NPCS then
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("Model")
                    and obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
                    best = considerTarget(obj, aimX, aimY, myHead, best)
                end
            end
        end

        return best.char
    end

    local function canFire()
        local tool = Pl.Tool
        if not tool or not tool.Parent then return false end
        if tool:GetAttribute("Local_IsShooting") then return false end
        if (tool:GetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo") or 1) <= 0 then return false end
        if (tool:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") or 0) > 0 then return false end
        return true
    end

    local function sendClick()
        if not Pl.Shoot then return false end

        local ok = pcall(function()
            local obj = {
                UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
                UserInputType  = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,
                Position       = Vector3.zero,
            }
            task.spawn(Pl.Shoot, obj)
            obj.UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.End
        end)

        if not ok then
            Pl.Shoot = nil
            Pl.Tool  = nil
            Pl.Data  = nil
        end
        return ok
    end

    local function sendReloadClick()
        if type(Pl.Reload) ~= "function" then return false end

        local ok = pcall(function()
            task.spawn(Pl.Reload)
        end)

        if not ok then
            Pl.Reload = nil
            return false
        end

        return true
    end

    local function fire(targetChar)
        if not targetChar or not isShootable(targetChar) then return end
        if not hasLineOfSight(targetChar) then return end
        sendClick()
    end

    local function tryReloadClick()
        local tool = Pl.Tool
        if not tool or not tool.Parent then return end

        local ammo = tool:GetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo") or 0
        if ammo > 0 then
            ReloadFired = false
            return
        end

        if ReloadFired then return end

        if tool:GetAttribute("Local_IsShooting") then return end
        if (tool:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") or 0) > 0 then return end

        if type(Pl.Reload) == "function" then
            sendReloadClick()
            ReloadFired = (tool:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") or 0) > 0
        else
            ReloadFired = sendClick()
        end
    end

    local function startLoop()
        if Thread then return end
        LoopId = LoopId + 1
        local myId = LoopId

        Thread = task.spawn(function()
            while Enabled and LoopId == myId do
                local ok = pcall(function()
                    local target = getTarget()
                    if target and canFire() then
                        fire(target)
                    end
                    tryReloadClick()
                end)

                if not ok then
                    Pl.Shoot  = nil
                    Pl.Reload = nil
                    Pl.Tool   = nil
                    Pl.Data   = nil
                    task.wait(1)
                    refreshShootCache()
                end

                task.wait(LOOP_DELAY)
            end

            if LoopId == myId then
                Thread = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    local function stopLoop()
        LoopId = LoopId + 1
        Thread = nil
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true
        ReloadFired = false

        buildRing()
        updateRing()
        setRingVisible(true)

        CharAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            Pl.Tool     = nil
            Pl.Data     = nil
            Pl.Reload   = nil
            ReloadFired = false
        end)

        if not Pl.Shoot then
            task.spawn(function()
                for _ = 1, 40 do
                    if not Enabled then return end
                    if refreshShootCache() then break end
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end)
        end

        startLoop()
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        setRingVisible(false)
