        if CharAddedConn then
            CharAddedConn:Disconnect()
            CharAddedConn = nil
        end

        stopLoop()

        Pl.Shoot    = nil
        Pl.Reload   = nil
        Pl.Tool     = nil
        Pl.Data     = nil
        ReloadFired = false
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,

        SetFOV = function(v)
            FOV_RADIUS = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or FOV_RADIUS, 50, 800)
            updateRing()
        end,

        SetRange = function(v)
            MANUAL_RANGE = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 0, 0, 5000)
        end,
    }
end)()

return {
    Triggerbot = Triggerbot,
}
end)()

__bundle["ESP"] = (function()
local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local ESP = (function()
    local TEAM_COLORS = {
        Inmates   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0),
        Guards    = Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 255),
        Criminals = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
    }
    local DEFAULT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)

    local MAX_DISTANCE   = 100000
    local UPDATE_RATE    = 1 / 30
    local HEAD_OFFSET    = 2.4
    local BILLBOARD_SIZE = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 34)
    local NAME_SIZE      = 12
    local INFO_SIZE      = 10
    local INFO_GAP       = 8

    local Enabled      = false
    local ShowChams    = true
    local ShowName     = true
    local ShowDistance = true
    local ShowHP       = true

    local cache             = {}
    local RenderConn        = nil
    local PlayerAddedConn   = nil
    local PlayerRemovedConn = nil
    local CharConns         = {}

    local function getTeamColor(player)
        local team = player.Team
        if team and TEAM_COLORS[team.Name] then
            return TEAM_COLORS[team.Name]
        end
        return DEFAULT_COLOR
    end

    local function removeEntry(player)
        local entry = cache[player]
        if not entry then return end
        if entry.highlight and entry.highlight.Parent then
            pcall(function() entry.highlight:Destroy() end)
        end
        if entry.billboard and entry.billboard.Parent then
            pcall(function() entry.billboard:Destroy() end)
        end
        cache[player] = nil
    end

    local function makeInfoLabel(name, order, color)
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Name                   = name
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 12)
        lbl.AutomaticSize          = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
        lbl.FontFace               = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
        lbl.TextSize               = INFO_SIZE
        lbl.TextColor3             = color
        lbl.TextTransparency       = 0.05
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.7
        lbl.TextStrokeColor3       = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        lbl.TextWrapped            = false
        lbl.Text                   = ""
        lbl.LayoutOrder            = order
        return lbl
    end

    local function buildBillboard(player, head, color)
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name                  = "ParallaxESP"
        bb.Adornee               = head
        bb.Size                  = BILLBOARD_SIZE
        bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, HEAD_OFFSET, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop           = true
        bb.MaxDistance           = MAX_DISTANCE
        bb.LightInfluence        = 0
        bb.ResetOnSpawn          = false
        bb.Parent                = head

        local container = Instance.new("Frame")
        container.Name                   = "Container"
        container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        container.Size                   = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        container.Parent                 = bb

        local vLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        vLayout.FillDirection       = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
        vLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
        vLayout.VerticalAlignment   = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        vLayout.SortOrder           = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        vLayout.Padding             = UDim.new(0, 1)
        vLayout.Parent              = container

        local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
        padding.PaddingLeft   = UDim.new(0, 6)
        padding.PaddingRight  = UDim.new(0, 6)
        padding.PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, 3)
        padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 3)
        padding.Parent        = container

        local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        nameLabel.Name                   = "NameLabel"
        nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLabel.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
        nameLabel.FontFace               = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamBold)
        nameLabel.TextSize               = NAME_SIZE
        nameLabel.TextColor3             = color
        nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
        nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3       = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        nameLabel.Text                   = player.DisplayName
        nameLabel.TextWrapped            = false
        nameLabel.TextTruncate           = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        nameLabel.LayoutOrder            = 1
        nameLabel.Visible                = ShowName
        nameLabel.Parent                 = container

        local infoRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        infoRow.Name                   = "InfoRow"
        infoRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        infoRow.Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 12)
        infoRow.AutomaticSize          = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
        infoRow.LayoutOrder            = 2
        infoRow.Parent                 = container

        local hLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        hLayout.FillDirection       = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        hLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
        hLayout.VerticalAlignment   = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        hLayout.SortOrder           = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        hLayout.Padding             = UDim.new(0, INFO_GAP)
        hLayout.Parent              = infoRow

        local distLabel = makeInfoLabel("DistLabel", 1, color)
        distLabel.Text    = "0 studs"
        distLabel.Visible = ShowDistance
        distLabel.Parent  = infoRow

        local hpLabel = makeInfoLabel("HpLabel", 2, color)
        hpLabel.Text    = "0 HP"
        hpLabel.Visible = ShowHP
        hpLabel.Parent  = infoRow

        return bb, distLabel, hpLabel, nameLabel
    end

    local function createEntry(player, character)
        removeEntry(player)
        if not Enabled then return end
        if player == LocalPlayer then return end
        if not character or not character.Parent then return end

        local color = getTeamColor(player)

        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name                = "ParallaxESPOutline"
        hl.Adornee             = character
        hl.FillTransparency    = 1
        hl.OutlineTransparency = ShowChams and 0 or 1
        hl.OutlineColor        = color
        hl.DepthMode           = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent              = character

        local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if not head or not character.Parent then
            if hl.Parent then hl:Destroy() end
            return
        end

        local bb, distLabel, hpLabel, nameLabel = buildBillboard(player, head, color)

        cache[player] = {
            highlight = hl,
            billboard = bb,
            distLabel = distLabel,
            hpLabel   = hpLabel,
            nameLabel = nameLabel,
            character = character,
            color     = color,
        }
    end

    local function onCharacter(player, char)
        if not Enabled then return end
        if player == LocalPlayer then return end
        task.wait(0.15)
        if not Enabled then return end
        if player.Parent and player.Character == char then
            createEntry(player, char)
        end
    end

    local function bindPlayer(player)
        if player == LocalPlayer then return end
        if CharConns[player] then return end
        CharConns[player] = {}

        CharConns[player][1] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.spawn(onCharacter, player, char)
        end)
        CharConns[player][2] = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
            removeEntry(player)
        end)
        CharConns[player][3] = player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
            if player.Character and player.Character.Parent then
                createEntry(player, player.Character)
            else
                removeEntry(player)
            end
        end)

        if player.Character then
            task.spawn(createEntry, player, player.Character)
        end
    end

    local function unbindPlayer(player)
        removeEntry(player)
        local list = CharConns[player]
        if list then
            for _, c in ipairs(list) do
                if c and c.Disconnect then
                    pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                end
            end
        end
        CharConns[player] = nil
    end

    local function clearAll()
        for player in pairs(cache) do
            removeEntry(player)
        end
        cache = {}
    end

    local function refreshLabels()
        for _, entry in pairs(cache) do
            if entry.nameLabel and entry.nameLabel.Parent then
                entry.nameLabel.Visible = ShowName
            end
            if entry.distLabel and entry.distLabel.Parent then
                entry.distLabel.Visible = ShowDistance
            end
            if entry.hpLabel and entry.hpLabel.Parent then
                entry.hpLabel.Visible = ShowHP
            end
            if entry.highlight and entry.highlight.Parent then
                entry.highlight.OutlineTransparency = ShowChams and 0 or 1
            end
        end
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            bindPlayer(plr)
        end

        PlayerAddedConn   = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bindPlayer)
        PlayerRemovedConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(unbindPlayer)

        local accumulator = 0
        RenderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not Enabled then return end
            accumulator += dt
            if accumulator < UPDATE_RATE then return end
            accumulator = 0

            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position

            local toRemove
            for player, entry in pairs(cache) do
                local char = entry.character
                if not char or not char.Parent then
                    toRemove = toRemove or {}
                    table.insert(toRemove, player)
                    continue
                end

                local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hrp or not hum then continue end

                local dist = (hrp.Position - camPos).Magnitude
                local visible = dist <= MAX_DISTANCE

                if entry.billboard and entry.billboard.Parent then
                    entry.billboard.Enabled = visible
                end

                if visible then
                    if entry.distLabel and entry.distLabel.Parent then
                        entry.distLabel.Text = string.format("%d studs", math.floor(dist))
                    end
                    if entry.hpLabel and entry.hpLabel.Parent then
                        local hp = math.max(0, math.floor(hum.Health))
                        entry.hpLabel.Text = string.format("%d HP", hp)
                    end
                end
            end

            if toRemove then
                for _, p in ipairs(toRemove) do
                    removeEntry(p)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        if RenderConn then RenderConn:Disconnect() RenderConn = nil end
        if PlayerAddedConn then PlayerAddedConn:Disconnect() PlayerAddedConn = nil end
        if PlayerRemovedConn then PlayerRemovedConn:Disconnect() PlayerRemovedConn = nil end

        for player in pairs(CharConns) do
            local list = CharConns[player]
            if list then
                for _, c in ipairs(list) do
                    if c and c.Disconnect then
                        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        CharConns = {}

        clearAll()
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,

        SetChams = function(v)
            ShowChams = v == true
            if Enabled then refreshLabels() end
        end,
        SetDisplayName = function(v)
            ShowName = v == true
            if Enabled then refreshLabels() end
        end,
        SetDistance = function(v)
            ShowDistance = v == true
            if Enabled then refreshLabels() end
        end,
        SetHP = function(v)
            ShowHP = v == true
            if Enabled then refreshLabels() end
        end,
    }
end)()

return { ESP = ESP }
end)()

__bundle["Tracers"] = (function()
local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Tracers = (function()
    if type(Drawing) ~= "table" or type(Drawing.new) ~= "function" then
        return { Set = function() end, Get = function() return false end }
    end

    local CONFIG = {
        TracerThickness  = 2,
        OutlineThickness = 1,
        OutlineEnabled   = true,
    }

    local TEAM_COLORS = {
        ["Criminals"] = Color3.fromRGB(255,  90,  90),
        ["Guards"]    = Color3.fromRGB( 90, 160, 255),
        ["Inmates"]   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170,  80),
    }

    local DEFAULT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    local OUTLINE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB( 20,  20,  20)

    local Enabled        = false
    local TracerList     = {}
    local RenderConn     = nil
    local PlayerAddedConn = nil
    local PlayerRemovedConn = nil
    local CharAddedConns = {}

    local function getTeamColor(player)
        local team = player.Team
        if team and TEAM_COLORS[team.Name] then
            return TEAM_COLORS[team.Name]
        end
        return DEFAULT_COLOR
    end

    local function getTracerOrigin()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return Vector2.new(0, 0) end

        local vp = cam.ViewportSize
        local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)

        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myRoot then return center end

        local myHead = myChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if myHead and (cam.CFrame.Position - myHead.Position).Magnitude < 2 then
            return center
        end

        local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(myRoot.Position)
        if onScreen then
            return Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
        end
        return center
    end

    local function newLine(thickness, color, z)
        local l = Drawing.new("Line")
        l.Visible, l.Color, l.Thickness, l.Transparency = false, color, thickness, 1
        l.ZIndex = z or 2
        return l
    end

    local function removeESP(player)
        local state = TracerList[player]
        if not state then return end
        for _, obj in pairs(state) do
            if obj and obj.Remove then
                pcall(function() obj:Remove() end)
            end
        end
        TracerList[player] = nil
    end

    local function createESP(player)
        if player == LocalPlayer then return end
        if TracerList[player] then removeESP(player) end

        local color = getTeamColor(player)

        TracerList[player] = {
            tracerOutline = newLine(
                CONFIG.TracerThickness + CONFIG.OutlineThickness * 2,
                OUTLINE_COLOR,
                1
            ),
            tracer = newLine(CONFIG.TracerThickness, color, 2),
        }
    end

    local function hideAll(state)
        for _, obj in pairs(state) do
            obj.Visible = false
        end
    end

    local function onCharacter(player, char)
        if not Enabled then return end
        if player == LocalPlayer then return end
        if not char or not char.Parent then return end
        createESP(player)
    end

    local function bindPlayer(player)
        if player == LocalPlayer then return end
        if CharAddedConns[player] then return end
        CharAddedConns[player] = {}

        CharAddedConns[player][1] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.defer(onCharacter, player, char)
        end)

        createESP(player)
    end

    local function unbindPlayer(player)
        removeESP(player)

        local list = CharAddedConns[player]
        if list then
            for _, c in ipairs(list) do
                if c and c.Disconnect then
                    pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                end
            end
        end
        CharAddedConns[player] = nil
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            bindPlayer(plr)
        end

        PlayerAddedConn   = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bindPlayer)
        PlayerRemovedConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(unbindPlayer)

        RenderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not Enabled then return end

            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end

            local origin = getTracerOrigin()

            for player, state in pairs(TracerList) do
                local char = player.Character
                local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if not (humanoid and rootPart) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                    hideAll(state)
                else
                    local rootPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position)
                    if not onScreen then
                        hideAll(state)
                    else
                        local color = getTeamColor(player)
                        local target = Vector2.new(rootPos.X, rootPos.Y)

                        state.tracer.Color        = color
                        state.tracer.From         = origin
                        state.tracer.To           = target
                        state.tracerOutline.Color = OUTLINE_COLOR
                        state.tracerOutline.From  = origin
                        state.tracerOutline.To    = target

                        state.tracer.Visible        = true
                        state.tracerOutline.Visible = CONFIG.OutlineEnabled
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        if RenderConn then RenderConn:Disconnect() RenderConn = nil end
        if PlayerAddedConn then PlayerAddedConn:Disconnect() PlayerAddedConn = nil end
        if PlayerRemovedConn then PlayerRemovedConn:Disconnect() PlayerRemovedConn = nil end

        for player in pairs(CharAddedConns) do
            local list = CharAddedConns[player]
            if list then
                for _, c in ipairs(list) do
                    if c and c.Disconnect then
                        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        CharAddedConns = {}

        for player in pairs(TracerList) do
            removeESP(player)
        end
        TracerList = {}
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

return {
    Tracers = Tracers,
}
end)()

__bundle["KillFeed"] = (function()
local KillFeed = (function()
    local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local TweenService      = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local UserInputService  = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local RunService        = game:GetService("RunService")

    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local IS_MOBILE = UserInputService.TouchEnabled
        and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled

    local Theme = {
        Surface  = Color3.fromRGB(9,   9,   11),
        Surface3 = Color3.fromRGB(26,  26,  29),
        Stroke   = Color3.fromRGB(24,  24,  28),
        Accent   = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250),
        Text     = Color3.fromRGB(232, 232, 238),
        Muted    = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 120),
    }

    local PURE_WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

    local CONFIG = {
        Corner       = "TopRight",

        MaxEntries   = IS_MOBILE and 4 or 5,
        Hold         = 5,
        InTime       = 0.38,
        OutTime      = 0.26,

        Height       = IS_MOBILE and 28 or 32,
        Spacing      = IS_MOBILE and 5 or 6,

        MaxWidth     = IS_MOBILE and 300 or 420,

        SideOffset   = IS_MOBILE and 10 or 18,
        TopOffset    = IS_MOBILE and 12 or 18,
        BottomOffset = IS_MOBILE and 55 or 155,

        FontSize     = IS_MOBILE and 13 or 15,
        HealthSize   = IS_MOBILE and 12 or 14,

        StripWidth   = IS_MOBILE and 2 or 3,
        RowPadding   = IS_MOBILE and 5 or 7,
        CornerRadius = IS_MOBILE and 6 or 8,

        WeaponWidth  = IS_MOBILE and 38 or 50,
        WeaponHeight = IS_MOBILE and 22 or 28,

        ProgressHeight = 2,
        ProgressAlpha  = 0.55,

        SnowPerEntry   = IS_MOBILE and 8 or 12,
    }

    local FONT_FAMILY = "rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json"

    local FONT_REG
    local FONT_BOLD

    do
        local okR, reg = pcall(function()
            return Font.new(FONT_FAMILY, Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
        end)
        local okB, bold = pcall(function()
            return Font.new(FONT_FAMILY, Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
        end)

        FONT_REG  = okR and reg  or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Gotham)
        FONT_BOLD = okB and bold or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamBold)
    end

    local WEAPON_SHEET      = "rbxassetid://93481383611512"
    local WEAPON_RECT_SIZE  = Vector2.new(256, 128)

    local WEAPON_ICONS = {
        ["FAL"]           = { Image = WEAPON_SHEET, Offset = Vector2.new(0, 0),     Size = WEAPON_RECT_SIZE },
        ["REMINGTON 870"] = { Image = WEAPON_SHEET, Offset = Vector2.new(256, 0),   Size = WEAPON_RECT_SIZE },
        ["AK-47"]         = { Image = WEAPON_SHEET, Offset = Vector2.new(0, 128),   Size = WEAPON_RECT_SIZE },
        ["M700"]          = { Image = WEAPON_SHEET, Offset = Vector2.new(256, 128), Size = WEAPON_RECT_SIZE },
        ["M4A1"]          = { Image = WEAPON_SHEET, Offset = Vector2.new(0, 256),   Size = WEAPON_RECT_SIZE },
        ["MP5"]           = { Image = WEAPON_SHEET, Offset = Vector2.new(0, 384),   Size = WEAPON_RECT_SIZE },
        ["M9"]            = { Image = "rbxassetid://15571374043", Offset = nil, Size = nil },
        ["REVOLVER"]      = { Image = "rbxassetid://16057573220", Offset = nil, Size = nil },
    }

    local function getWeaponIcon(weaponName)
        if not weaponName then return nil end
        weaponName = weaponName:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

        local icon = WEAPON_ICONS[weaponName]
        if icon then return icon end

        local lowerName = string.lower(weaponName)
        for name, data in pairs(WEAPON_ICONS) do
            if string.lower(name) == lowerName then
                return data
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local Enabled = false

    local gui
    local feed
    local feedLayout
    local camera
    local feedWidth = CONFIG.MaxWidth

    local activeEntries = {}
    local entryOrder    = 0

    local healthCache    = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local trackedPlayers = {}

    local playerAddedConn
    local playerRemovingConn
    local viewportConn

    local killfeedInst
    local killfeedConn
    local childNameConns = {}

    local processed  = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local recentText = {}
    local RECENT_WINDOW = 0.6

    local function tween(inst, time, goal, style, dir)
        return TweenService:Create(
            inst,
            TweenInfo.new(
                time,
                style or Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
                dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            goal
        )
    end

    local function updateWidth()
        if not feed or not camera then return end

        local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
        local ratio    = IS_MOBILE and 0.62 or 0.36

        feedWidth = math.clamp(
            viewport.X * ratio,
            200,
            CONFIG.MaxWidth
        )

        feed.Size = UDim2.new(0, feedWidth, 0, 0)
    end

    local function newTextLabel(text, color, face, size, order)
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
        label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
        label.Text = text
        label.TextColor3 = color
        label.TextSize = size
        label.FontFace = face
        label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        label.TextTransparency = 1
        label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
        label.LayoutOrder = order
        label.ZIndex = 3
        return label
    end

    local function createWeaponIcon(weaponName)
        local data = getWeaponIcon(weaponName)
        if not data then return nil end

        local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        icon.Name = "WeaponIcon"
        icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        icon.Image = data.Image

        if data.Size then
            icon.ImageRectOffset = data.Offset
            icon.ImageRectSize   = data.Size
        end

        icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
            CONFIG.WeaponWidth,
            CONFIG.WeaponHeight
        )
        icon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        icon.ImageTransparency = 1
        icon.LayoutOrder = 5
        icon.ZIndex = 3

        return icon
    end

    local function parseKill(raw)
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return nil end

        local killerRaw, victimRaw, weapon = raw:match(
            "^(.-)%s+[Kk]illed%s+(.+)%s+[Ww]ith%s+(.+)$"
        )

        if not killerRaw or not victimRaw then
            killerRaw, victimRaw = raw:match(
                "^(.-)%s+[Kk]illed%s+(.+)$"
            )
            weapon = nil
        end

        if not killerRaw or not victimRaw then return nil end

        local username = killerRaw:match("@([%w_]+)")

        local killerDisplay = killerRaw
            :gsub("%s*%b()%s*$", "")
            :gsub("^%s+", "")
            :gsub("%s+$", "")

        local victimDisplay = victimRaw
            :gsub("%s*%b()%s*$", "")
            :gsub("^%s+", "")
            :gsub("%s+$", "")

        if weapon then
            weapon = weapon:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        end

        if killerDisplay == "" or victimDisplay == "" then return nil end

        return {
            killerDisplay  = killerDisplay,
            killerUsername = username,
            victimDisplay  = victimDisplay,
            weapon         = weapon,
        }
    end

    local function findByUsername(username)
        if not username then return nil end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Name == username then return p end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function findByDisplayName(display)
        if not display then return nil end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.DisplayName == display then return p end
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Name == display then return p end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function attachToCharacter(player, char)
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not hum or not Enabled then return end

        local entry = trackedPlayers[player]
        if not entry then return end

        healthCache[player] = { cur = hum.Health, max = hum.MaxHealth }

        if entry.humConn then entry.humConn:Disconnect() end
        entry.humConn = hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
            local c = healthCache[player]
            if c then
                c.cur = h
                c.max = hum.MaxHealth
            else
                healthCache[player] = { cur = h, max = hum.MaxHealth }
            end
        end)
    end

    local function trackPlayer(player)
        if trackedPlayers[player] then return end
        local entry = {}
        trackedPlayers[player] = entry

        entry.charConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            attachToCharacter(player, char)
        end)

        if player.Character then
            attachToCharacter(player, player.Character)
        end
    end

    local function untrackPlayer(player)
        local entry = trackedPlayers[player]
        if not entry then return end

        if entry.charConn then entry.charConn:Disconnect() end
        if entry.humConn  then entry.humConn:Disconnect()  end

        trackedPlayers[player] = nil
        healthCache[player]    = nil
    end

    local function untrackAll()
        for player in pairs(trackedPlayers) do
            untrackPlayer(player)
        end
        trackedPlayers = {}
        healthCache    = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    end

    local function createEntrySnow(parent, maxParticles)
        local particles = {}
        local clock     = 0

        local function newParticle()
            local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            frame.BackgroundColor3 = PURE_WHITE
            frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
            frame.ZIndex = 1

            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            corner.Parent = frame

            local radius = math.random() * 1.4 + 0.7
            local alpha  = math.random() * 0.35 + 0.18

            frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(radius, radius)
            frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - alpha
            frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(), math.random())
            frame.Parent = parent

            return {
                Frame = frame,
                Speed = (math.random() * 55 + 30) / 1000,
                Sway  = math.random() * 1.1 + 0.4,
                Phase = math.random() * 6.283185,
                Amp   = (math.random() * 8 + 3) / 1000,
                X     = math.random(),
                Y     = math.random(),
            }
        end

        for i = 1, maxParticles do
            particles[#particles + 1] = newParticle()
        end

        local renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)
            clock += dt

            for i = 1, #particles do
                local p = particles[i]
                p.Y += p.Speed * dt
                if p.Y > 1.06 then
                    p.Y = -0.06
                    p.X = math.random()
                end
                p.Frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(
                    p.X + math.sin(clock * p.Sway + p.Phase) * p.Amp,
                    p.Y
                )
            end
        end)

        return {
            Destroy = function()
                renderConn:Disconnect()
                for _, p in ipairs(particles) do
                    p.Frame:Destroy()
                end
            end,
        }
    end

    local function removeEntry(record)
        if record.removed then return end
        record.removed = true

        if record.snow then
            record.snow.Destroy()
            record.snow = nil
        end

        for i = #activeEntries, 1, -1 do
            if activeEntries[i] == record then
                table.remove(activeEntries, i)
                break
            end
        end

        for _, d in ipairs(record.animateOut) do
            tween(d.inst, CONFIG.OutTime, d.goal):Play()
        end

        task.delay(CONFIG.OutTime * 0.5, function()
            if record.frame.Parent then
                tween(
                    record.frame,
                    CONFIG.OutTime,
                    { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) },
                    Enum.EasingStyle.Sine
                ):Play()
            end
        end)

        task.delay(CONFIG.OutTime + 0.2, function()
            if record.frame.Parent then
                record.frame:Destroy()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function addKill(rawName)
        if not Enabled or not feed then return end

        local info = parseKill(rawName)
        if not info then return end

        local topCorner = CONFIG.Corner ~= "BottomRight"

        local killerPlayer = findByUsername(info.killerUsername)
            or findByDisplayName(info.killerDisplay)

        local killerHealth
        local killerMaxHealth

        do
            local cached = killerPlayer and healthCache[killerPlayer]
            if cached and cached.cur and cached.cur > 0 then
                killerHealth    = math.floor(cached.cur + 0.5)
                killerMaxHealth = cached.max or 100
            end
        end

        entryOrder += 1

        local entry = Instance.new("Frame")
        entry.Name = "Kill"
        entry.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        entry.ClipsDescendants = true
        entry.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
        entry.LayoutOrder = topCorner and -entryOrder or entryOrder
        entry.Parent = feed

        local pill = Instance.new("Frame")
        pill.Name = "Pill"
        pill.AnchorPoint = topCorner and Vector2.new(0.5, 0) or Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
        pill.Position = topCorner
            and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
            or  UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
        pill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, CONFIG.Height)
        pill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Surface
        pill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        pill.ClipsDescendants = true
        pill.Parent = entry

        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, CONFIG.CornerRadius)
        corner.Parent = pill

        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Color = Theme.Stroke
        stroke.Thickness = 1
        stroke.Transparency = 1
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Parent = pill

        local snowHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
        snowHolder.Name = "Snow"
        snowHolder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        snowHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        snowHolder.ClipsDescendants = true
        snowHolder.ZIndex = 1
        snowHolder.Parent = pill

        local snowModule = createEntrySnow(snowHolder, CONFIG.SnowPerEntry)

        local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
        strip.Name = "Strip"
        strip.Size = UDim2.new(0, CONFIG.StripWidth, 1, 0)
        strip.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
        strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        strip.BorderSizePixel = 0
        strip.ZIndex = 2
        strip.Parent = pill

        local row = Instance.new("Frame")
        row.Name = "Row"
        row.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        row.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(CONFIG.StripWidth + 22), 1, 0)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        row.ZIndex = 2
        row.Parent = pill

        local rowLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        rowLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        rowLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
        rowLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        rowLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        rowLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, CONFIG.RowPadding)
        rowLayout.Parent = row

        local nameLimit = math.max(56, (feedWidth - 190) / 2)

        local labels = {}
        local icons  = {}

        do
            local label = newTextLabel(
                info.killerDisplay,
                Theme.Text,
                FONT_BOLD,
                CONFIG.FontSize,
                1
            )
            label.Parent = row

            local limiter = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
            limiter.MaxSize = Vector2.new(nameLimit, math.huge)
            limiter.Parent = label

            labels[#labels + 1] = label
        end

        if killerHealth then
            local label = newTextLabel(
                "[" .. killerHealth .. "]",
                PURE_WHITE,
                FONT_BOLD,
                CONFIG.HealthSize,
                2
            )
            label.Parent = row
            labels[#labels + 1] = label
        end

        do
            local label = newTextLabel(
                "killed",
                Theme.Muted,
                FONT_REG,
                CONFIG.FontSize,
                3
            )
            label.Parent = row
            labels[#labels + 1] = label
        end

        do
            local label = newTextLabel(
                info.victimDisplay,
                Theme.Text,
                FONT_BOLD,
                CONFIG.FontSize,
                4
            )
            label.Parent = row

            local limiter = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
            limiter.MaxSize = Vector2.new(nameLimit, math.huge)
            limiter.Parent = label

            labels[#labels + 1] = label
        end

        do
            local icon = createWeaponIcon(info.weapon)
            if icon then
                icon.LayoutOrder = 5
                icon.Parent = row
                icons[#icons + 1] = icon
            end
        end

        local progressTrack = Instance.new("Frame")
        progressTrack.Name = "ProgressTrack"
        progressTrack.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
        progressTrack.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
        progressTrack.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, CONFIG.ProgressHeight)
        progressTrack.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Surface3
        progressTrack.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        progressTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
        progressTrack.ZIndex = 5
        progressTrack.Parent = pill

        local progressFill = Instance.new("Frame")
        progressFill.Name = "ProgressFill"
        progressFill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        progressFill.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        progressFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        progressFill.BackgroundColor3 = PURE_WHITE
        progressFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        progressFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        progressFill.ZIndex = 6
        progressFill.Parent = progressTrack

        local animateOut = {
            { inst = pill,          goal = { BackgroundTransparency = 1 } },
            { inst = strip,         goal = { BackgroundTransparency = 1 } },
            { inst = stroke,        goal = { Transparency = 1 } },
            { inst = progressTrack, goal = { BackgroundTransparency = 1 } },
            { inst = progressFill,  goal = { BackgroundTransparency = 1 } },
        }

        for _, label in ipairs(labels) do
            table.insert(animateOut, {
                inst = label,
                goal = {
                    TextTransparency = 1,
                    TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
                },
            })
        end

        for _, icon in ipairs(icons) do
            table.insert(animateOut, {
                inst = icon,
                goal = { ImageTransparency = 1 },
            })
        end

        local record = {
            frame         = entry,
            pill          = pill,
            strip         = strip,
            labels        = labels,
            icons         = icons,
            progressTrack = progressTrack,
            progressFill  = progressFill,
            snow          = snowModule,
            animateOut    = animateOut,
            removed       = false,
        }

        activeEntries[#activeEntries + 1] = record

        tween(
            entry,
            CONFIG.InTime,
            { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, CONFIG.Height) },
            Enum.EasingStyle.Sine
        ):Play()

        tween(
            pill,
            CONFIG.InTime,
            { BackgroundTransparency = 0.08 }
        ):Play()

        tween(
            stroke,
            CONFIG.InTime,
            { Transparency = 0.6 }
        ):Play()

        task.delay(0.04, function()
            if record.removed then return end
            tween(
                strip,
                CONFIG.InTime * 0.9,
                { BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 }
            ):Play()
        end)

        task.delay(0.06, function()
            if record.removed then return end
            tween(
                progressTrack,
                CONFIG.InTime,
                { BackgroundTransparency = 0.75 }
            ):Play()
            tween(
                progressFill,
                CONFIG.InTime,
                { BackgroundTransparency = CONFIG.ProgressAlpha }
            ):Play()
        end)

        for i, label in ipairs(labels) do
            local delayTime = 0.06 + 0.05 * (i - 1)
            task.delay(delayTime, function()
                if record.removed then return end
                tween(
                    label,
                    CONFIG.InTime * 0.85,
                    {
                        TextTransparency = 0,
                        TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3,
                    }
                ):Play()
            end)
        end

        for i, icon in ipairs(icons) do
            local delayTime = 0.12 + 0.05 * (i - 1)
            task.delay(delayTime, function()
                if record.removed then return end
                tween(
                    icon,
                    CONFIG.InTime * 0.85,
                    { ImageTransparency = 0 }
                ):Play()
            end)
        end

        task.delay(0.15, function()
            if record.removed then return end
            tween(
                progressFill,
                CONFIG.Hold,
                { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0) },
                Enum.EasingStyle.Linear
            ):Play()
        end)

        task.delay(CONFIG.Hold, function()
            removeEntry(record)
        end)

        while #activeEntries > CONFIG.MaxEntries do
            removeEntry(activeEntries[1])
        end
    end

    local function process(child)
        local name = child.Name
        if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return end
        if processed[child] == name then return end

        processed[child] = name

        local now = os.clock()
        for text, stamp in pairs(recentText) do
            if now - stamp > RECENT_WINDOW then
                recentText[text] = nil
            end
        end

        if recentText[name] then return end
        recentText[name] = now

        addKill(name)
    end

    local function watch(child)
        if childNameConns[child] then return end
        childNameConns[child] = child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"):Connect(function()
            process(child)
        end)
    end

    local function unwatchAll()
        for _, conn in pairs(childNameConns) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        childNameConns = {}
    end

    local function buildGui()
        local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
        if not playerGui then return false end

        local topCorner = CONFIG.Corner ~= "BottomRight"

        gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "ParallaxKillFeed"
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        gui.DisplayOrder = 5
        gui.Parent = playerGui

        feed = Instance.new("Frame")
        feed.Name = "Feed"
        feed.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, topCorner and 0 or 1)
        feed.Position = topCorner
            and UDim2.new(1, -CONFIG.SideOffset, 0, CONFIG.TopOffset)
            or  UDim2.new(1, -CONFIG.SideOffset, 1, -CONFIG.BottomOffset)
        feed.Size = UDim2.new(0, feedWidth, 0, 0)
        feed.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        feed.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        feed.Parent = gui

        feedLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        feedLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
        feedLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
        feedLayout.VerticalAlignment = topCorner
            and Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
            or  Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
        feedLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        feedLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, CONFIG.Spacing)
        feedLayout.Parent = feed

        updateWidth()
        return true
    end

    local function destroyGui()
        for _, record in ipairs(activeEntries) do
            record.removed = true
            if record.snow then
                record.snow.Destroy()
                record.snow = nil
            end
        end
        activeEntries = {}
        entryOrder    = 0

        if gui then
            gui:Destroy()
            gui = nil
        end
        feed       = nil
        feedLayout = nil
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end

        killfeedInst = killfeedInst
            or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Killfeed")
            or ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Killfeed", 20)

        if not killfeedInst then
            warn("[KillFeed] ReplicatedStorage.Killfeed was not found.")
            return
        end

        if not buildGui() then
            warn("[KillFeed] PlayerGui not available.")
            return
        end

        Enabled = true

        camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then
            viewportConn = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize")
                :Connect(updateWidth)
        end

        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            trackPlayer(p)
        end
        playerAddedConn    = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(trackPlayer)
        playerRemovingConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(untrackPlayer)

        for _, child in ipairs(killfeedInst:GetChildren()) do
            processed[child] = child.Name
            watch(child)
        end

        killfeedConn = killfeedInst.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            watch(child)
            process(child)
        end)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        if killfeedConn then killfeedConn:Disconnect() killfeedConn = nil end
        unwatchAll()

        if playerAddedConn    then playerAddedConn:Disconnect()    playerAddedConn    = nil end
        if playerRemovingConn then playerRemovingConn:Disconnect() playerRemovingConn = nil end
        untrackAll()

        if viewportConn then viewportConn:Disconnect() viewportConn = nil end

        destroyGui()
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

return { KillFeed = KillFeed }
end)()

__bundle["VehicleFly"] = (function()
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player   = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera   = workspace.CurrentCamera
local IS_TOUCH = UserInputService.TouchEnabled

local VehicleFly = (function()
    local SPEED          = 120
    local VERTICAL_SPEED = 80
    local GYRO_P         = 6e4
    local GYRO_D         = 2e3
    local YAW_RATE       = 10

    local COL_BG     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
    local COL_FG     = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
    local COL_STROKE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

    local FILL_TRANS   = 0.15
    local STROKE_TRANS = 0.78

    local Enabled     = false
    local flying      = false
    local vehicleSeat = nil
    local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro

    local joyVector        = Vector2.zero
    local upHeld, downHeld = false, false

    local RenderConn = nil

    local function round(obj)
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        c.Parent = obj
        return c
    end

    local function outline(obj, thickness, transparency)
        local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        s.Color = COL_STROKE
        s.Thickness = thickness
        s.Transparency = transparency
        s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        s.Parent = obj
        return s
    end

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "ParallaxVehicleFlyGui"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
    gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.Enabled = false
    gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    pcall(function()
        gui.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets
    end)

    local mobileLayer = Instance.new("Frame")
    mobileLayer.Name = "MobileControls"
    mobileLayer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    mobileLayer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    mobileLayer.Visible = false
    mobileLayer.Active = false
    mobileLayer.Parent = gui

    local joyOuter = Instance.new("Frame")
    joyOuter.Name = "Joystick"
    joyOuter.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
    joyOuter.BackgroundColor3 = COL_BG
    joyOuter.BackgroundTransparency = FILL_TRANS
    joyOuter.BorderSizePixel = 0
    joyOuter.Active = true
    joyOuter.Parent = mobileLayer
    round(joyOuter)
    outline(joyOuter, 1.5, STROKE_TRANS)

    local joyThumb = Instance.new("Frame")
    joyThumb.Name = "Thumb"
    joyThumb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    joyThumb.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    joyThumb.BackgroundColor3 = COL_FG
    joyThumb.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
    joyThumb.BorderSizePixel = 0
    joyThumb.Parent = joyOuter
    round(joyThumb)

    local function makeVertButton(glyph)
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = COL_BG
        b.BackgroundTransparency = FILL_TRANS
        b.TextColor3 = COL_FG
        b.Text = glyph
        b.TextSize = 20
        b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        b.AutoButtonColor = false
        b.BorderSizePixel = 0
        b.Active = true
        b.Parent = mobileLayer
        round(b)
        outline(b, 1.5, STROKE_TRANS)
        return b
    end

    local upButton   = makeVertButton("▲")
    local downButton = makeVertButton("▼")

    local joyRadius = 50

    local function layout()
        local vp    = camera.ViewportSize
        local short = math.min(vp.X, vp.Y)

        local joySize   = math.clamp(short * 0.34, 116, 176)
        local thumbSize = joySize * 0.36
        local btnSize   = joySize * 0.44
        local pad       = math.clamp(short * 0.05, 14, 32)
        local gap       = btnSize * 0.30

        joyOuter.Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(joySize, joySize)
        joyOuter.Position = UDim2.new(0, pad, 1, -pad)
        joyThumb.Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(thumbSize, thumbSize)
        joyThumb.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        joyRadius         = joySize * 0.5 - thumbSize * 0.5

        upButton.Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(btnSize, btnSize)
        upButton.TextSize = math.floor(btnSize * 0.42)
        upButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -pad, 1, -pad - btnSize - gap)

        downButton.Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(btnSize, btnSize)
        downButton.TextSize = math.floor(btnSize * 0.42)
        downButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -pad, 1, -pad)
    end

    layout()
    camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(layout)

    local function getVehicleRoot()
        if not vehicleSeat or not vehicleSeat.Parent then return nil end
        return vehicleSeat.AssemblyRootPart or vehicleSeat
    end

    local function currentSeat()
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return nil end
        local seat = hum.SeatPart
        if not seat or not seat:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return nil end
        return seat
    end

    local function resetMobileInput()
        joyVector = Vector2.zero
        upHeld, downHeld = false, false
        joyThumb.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        upButton.BackgroundTransparency   = FILL_TRANS
        downButton.BackgroundTransparency = FILL_TRANS
    end

    local function refreshUI()
        local seated = vehicleSeat ~= nil

        if not seated and flying then

            return
        end

        gui.Enabled = (flying and IS_TOUCH)
        mobileLayer.Visible = (flying and IS_TOUCH)
    end

    local function stopFlying()
        if not flying then return end
        flying = false

        if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
        if bodyGyro     then bodyGyro:Destroy()     bodyGyro     = nil end

        if vehicleSeat then
            local hum = vehicleSeat:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true end
        end

        resetMobileInput()
        gui.Enabled = false
        mobileLayer.Visible = false
    end

    local function startFlying()
        local root = getVehicleRoot()
        if not root then return end

        flying = true

        bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bodyVelocity.P        = 1250
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        bodyVelocity.Parent   = root

        bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bodyGyro.P         = GYRO_P
        bodyGyro.D         = GYRO_D
        bodyGyro.CFrame    = root.CFrame
        bodyGyro.Parent    = root

        local hum = vehicleSeat:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end

        gui.Enabled = IS_TOUCH
        mobileLayer.Visible = IS_TOUCH
    end

    local activeJoyInput = nil

    local function updateJoystick(inputPos)
        local center = joyOuter.AbsolutePosition + joyOuter.AbsoluteSize * 0.5
        local delta  = Vector2.new(inputPos.X - center.X, inputPos.Y - center.Y)
        local mag    = delta.Magnitude

        if mag < 0.0001 then
            joyVector = Vector2.zero
            joyThumb.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            return
        end

        local dir     = delta / mag
        local clamped = math.min(mag, joyRadius)

        joyThumb.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, dir.X * clamped, 0.5, dir.Y * clamped)
        joyVector = dir * (clamped / joyRadius)
    end

    joyOuter.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            activeJoyInput = input
            joyThumb.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            updateJoystick(input.Position)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == activeJoyInput then
            updateJoystick(input.Position)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input == activeJoyInput then
            activeJoyInput = nil
            joyVector = Vector2.zero
            joyThumb.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            joyThumb.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
        end
    end)

    local function bindHold(btn, setter)
        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                btn.BackgroundTransparency = FILL_TRANS * 0.4
                setter(true)
            end
        end)
        btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                btn.BackgroundTransparency = FILL_TRANS
                setter(false)
            end
        end)
    end

    bindHold(upButton,   function(v) upHeld   = v end)
    bindHold(downButton, function(v) downHeld = v end)

    local function loop(dt)
        if not Enabled then
            if flying then stopFlying() end
            return
        end

        local seat = currentSeat()
        if seat ~= vehicleSeat then
            vehicleSeat = seat
            if not vehicleSeat and flying then
                stopFlying()
            end
        end

        if Enabled and vehicleSeat and not flying then
            startFlying()
        end

        if not flying then return end

        local root = getVehicleRoot()
        if not root then
            stopFlying()
            return
        end

        local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local flat    = Vector3.new(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z)

        local _, currentYaw = root.CFrame:ToOrientation()

        if flat.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            flat = flat.Unit
            local targetYaw = math.atan2(-flat.X, -flat.Z)
            local delta     = (targetYaw - currentYaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
            local alpha     = 1 - math.exp(-YAW_RATE * dt)
            currentYaw      = currentYaw + delta * alpha
        end

        bodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, currentYaw, 0)

        local moveDir = Vector3.zero

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir += camera.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir -= camera.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir -= camera.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir += camera.CFrame.RightVector end

        if joyVector.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            moveDir += camera.CFrame.LookVector * (-joyVector.Y)
            moveDir += camera.CFrame.RightVector * joyVector.X
        end

        local vertical = 0
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or upHeld then
            vertical += 1
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
            or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) or downHeld then
            vertical -= 1
        end

        local velocity = Vector3.zero
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            velocity = moveDir.Unit * SPEED
        end
        velocity += Vector3.new(0, vertical * VERTICAL_SPEED, 0)

        bodyVelocity.Velocity = velocity
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true

        if not RenderConn then
            RenderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(loop)
        end

        vehicleSeat = currentSeat()
        if vehicleSeat then
            startFlying()
        end
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        if RenderConn then
            RenderConn:Disconnect()
            RenderConn = nil
        end

        if flying then stopFlying() end
        vehicleSeat = nil
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

return { VehicleFly = VehicleFly }
end)()

__bundle["VehicleSpeed"] = (function()
local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local VehicleSpeed = (function()
    local DEFAULT_SPEED = 200
    local TORQUE        = 4

    local Enabled       = false
    local SPEED         = DEFAULT_SPEED

    local original      = {}
    local lastSeat      = nil
    local cachedSeats   = {}
    local heartbeatConn = nil

    local function getCarContainer()
        return workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
    end

    local function isInCar(seat)
        local car = getCarContainer()
        return car and seat and seat:IsDescendantOf(car)
    end

    local function updateCachedSeats(seat)
        if seat == lastSeat then return end
        lastSeat = seat
        cachedSeats = {}
        if not seat then return end

        local vehicle = seat.Parent and seat.Parent.Parent
        if not vehicle then return end

        for _, desc in ipairs(vehicle:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
                table.insert(cachedSeats, desc)
            end
        end
    end

    local function applySpeed()
        if not Enabled then return end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local seat = hum and hum.SeatPart

        if isInCar(seat) then
            updateCachedSeats(seat)
            for _, vs in ipairs(cachedSeats) do
                if vs and vs.Parent then
                    if not original[vs] then
                        original[vs] = { MaxSpeed = vs.MaxSpeed, Torque = vs.Torque }
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        vs.MaxSpeed = SPEED
                        vs.Torque   = TORQUE
                    end)
                end
            end
        else
            lastSeat = nil
            cachedSeats = {}
        end
    end

    local function restoreAll()
        for seat, data in pairs(original) do
            if seat and seat.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    seat.MaxSpeed = data.MaxSpeed
                    seat.Torque   = data.Torque
                end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(original)
        lastSeat = nil
        cachedSeats = {}
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true
        if not heartbeatConn then
            heartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(applySpeed)
        end
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false
        if heartbeatConn then
            heartbeatConn:Disconnect()
            heartbeatConn = nil
        end
        restoreAll()
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
        SetSpeed = function(v)
            SPEED = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or SPEED, 0, 500)
        end,
    }
end)()

return { VehicleSpeed = VehicleSpeed }
end)()

__bundle["AntiInvisible"] = (function()
local AntiInvisible = (function()
    local ENTITYLIB_URL =
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7GrandDadPGN/VapeCompiled/refs/heads/main/libraries/entity.lua"

    local Enabled       = false
    local Notifier      = nil
    local entitylib     = nil
    local libStarted    = false
    local entAddedConn  = nil

    local animatorConns  = {}
    local activeThreads  = {}
    local alreadyFlagged = {}

    local whitelist = {
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=125750702"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=128777973"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=128853357"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=129423030"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=129423131"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=129967390"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=129967478"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=178130996"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=180426354"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=180435571"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=180435792"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=180436148"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=180436334"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=182393478"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=182435998"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=182436842"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=182436935"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=182491037"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=182491065"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=182491248"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=182491277"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=182491368"] = true,
        ["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=182491423"] = true,

        ["rbxassetid://279227693"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://279229192"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://287112271"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://388723916"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://388726667"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://389472570"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://405194080"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://405212265"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://481088553"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://481089053"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://484200742"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://484926359"]       = true,
        ["rbxassetid://83690472549256"]  = true,
        ["rbxassetid://107176344504758"] = true,
        ["rbxassetid://111090572475133"] = true,
        ["rbxassetid://113267949064300"] = true,
        ["rbxassetid://131326339350805"] = true,
    }

    pcall(function()
        local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        for _, obj in ReplicatedStorage:QueryDescendants("Animation") do
            if obj.AnimationId then
                whitelist[obj.AnimationId] = true
            end
        end
    end)

    local function fireNotify(plr)
        if type(Notifier) ~= "function" then return end
        task.spawn(function() pcall(Notifier, plr) end)
    end

    local function neutralizeAnimation(anim, plr)
        if activeThreads[anim] then
            pcall(task.cancel, activeThreads[anim])
        end

        activeThreads[anim] = task.spawn(function()
            while Enabled and anim.IsPlaying do
                pcall(function() anim:AdjustWeight(0, 0) end)
                task.wait()
            end
            activeThreads[anim] = nil
        end)

        if plr and not alreadyFlagged[plr] then
            alreadyFlagged[plr] = true
            fireNotify(plr)
        end
    end

    local function hookEntity(ent)
        if not Enabled then return end
        if not ent or not ent.Humanoid then return end
        if animatorConns[ent] then return end

        local animator = ent.Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            or ent.Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
        if not animator or not Enabled then return end

        animatorConns[ent] = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(anim)
            if not Enabled then return end
            local a = anim.Animation
            if not a or not a.AnimationId then return end
            if whitelist[a.AnimationId] then return end
            neutralizeAnimation(anim, ent.Player)
        end)

        for _, anim in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
            local a = anim.Animation
            if a and a.AnimationId and not whitelist[a.AnimationId] then
                task.spawn(neutralizeAnimation, anim, ent.Player)
            end
        end
    end

    local function onEntityAdded(ent)
        task.spawn(hookEntity, ent)
    end

    local function ensureEntityLib()
        if not entitylib then
            local ok, res = pcall(function()
                local src = game:HttpGet(ENTITYLIB_URL)
                return loadstring(src)()
            end)
            if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" then
                warn("[AntiInvisible] entitylib load failed: " .. tostring(res))
                return false
            end
            entitylib = res
        end

        if not libStarted then
            local ok, err = pcall(function() entitylib.start() end)
            if not ok then
                warn("[AntiInvisible] entitylib.start failed: " .. tostring(err))
                return false
            end
            libStarted = true
        end

        return true
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        if not ensureEntityLib() then return end

        Enabled         = true
        alreadyFlagged  = {}

        entAddedConn = entitylib.Events.EntityAdded:Connect(onEntityAdded)

        for _, ent in entitylib.List do
            task.spawn(hookEntity, ent)
        end
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        for anim, thread in pairs(activeThreads) do
            pcall(task.cancel, thread)
        end
        activeThreads = {}

        for ent, conn in pairs(animatorConns) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        animatorConns = {}

        if entAddedConn then
            entAddedConn:Disconnect()
            entAddedConn = nil
        end

        alreadyFlagged = {}
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
        SetNotifier = function(fn) Notifier = fn end,
    }
end)()

return { AntiInvisible = AntiInvisible }
end)()

__bundle["ExpandReach"] = (function()
local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local ExpandReach = (function()
    local HITBOX_SIZE = 15

    local Enabled            = false
    local originalData       = {}
    local HeartbeatConn      = nil
    local PlayerRemovingConn = nil

    local function applyHitbox(hrp)
        if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end

        if not originalData[hrp] then
            originalData[hrp] = {
                Size       = hrp.Size,
                CanCollide = hrp.CanCollide,
            }
        end

        pcall(function()
            hrp.Size       = Vector3.new(HITBOX_SIZE, HITBOX_SIZE, HITBOX_SIZE)
            hrp.CanCollide = false
        end)
    end

    local function restoreHitbox(hrp)
        local data = originalData[hrp]
        if data and hrp and hrp.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                hrp.Size       = data.Size
                hrp.CanCollide = data.CanCollide
            end)
        end
        originalData[hrp] = nil
    end

    local function restoreAll()
        for hrp, data in pairs(originalData) do
            if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    hrp.Size       = data.Size
                    hrp.CanCollide = data.CanCollide
                end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(originalData)
    end

    local function processPlayer(player)
        if player == LocalPlayer then return end

        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end

        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end

        applyHitbox(hrp)
    end

    local function tick()
        if not Enabled then
            if next(originalData) then restoreAll() end
            return
        end

        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            pcall(processPlayer, player)
        end

        for hrp in pairs(originalData) do
            if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then
                originalData[hrp] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true

        HeartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(tick)

        PlayerRemovingConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
            local char = player.Character
            if char then
                local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then restoreHitbox(hrp) end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false

        if HeartbeatConn then
            HeartbeatConn:Disconnect()
            HeartbeatConn = nil
        end
        if PlayerRemovingConn then
            PlayerRemovingConn:Disconnect()
            PlayerRemovingConn = nil
        end

        restoreAll()
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
        SetSize = function(v)
            HITBOX_SIZE = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or HITBOX_SIZE, 1, 50)
        end,
    }
end)()

return { ExpandReach = ExpandReach }
end)()

__bundle["VehicleFling"] = (function()
local VehicleFling = (function()
    local cloneref = cloneref or function(o) return o end

    local Players           = cloneref(game:GetService("Players"))
    local ReplicatedStorage = cloneref(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"))
    local RunService        = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Workspace         = game:GetService("Workspace")

    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local CONFIG = {
        MAX_CARS       = 8,
        CAR_LIFETIME   = 2.5,
        OSCILLATE      = true,
        OSC_PERIOD     = 1.6,
        POS_A          = Vector3.new(624.04, 95.30, 2494.65),
        POS_B          = Vector3.new(589.04, 95.30, 2494.25),
        BUTTON_INDEX_A = 4,
        BUTTON_INDEX_B = 5,

        KICK_WAIT      = 0.5,
    }

    local Enabled             = false
    local TargetName          = nil
    local TargetDisplay       = nil
    local LoopActive          = false
    local Thread              = nil
    local Notifier            = nil

    local pendingKicked       = nil
    local targetDeathNotified = false

    local oscConnection = nil
    local oscStart      = 0
    local lastEnd       = nil
    local lastSpawn     = 0

    local carPool        = {}
    local carPoolConn    = nil
    local carPoolRunning = false
    local carPoolThread  = nil

    local msgConn = nil

    local Remote, Buttons, CarContainer = nil, nil, nil
    local SPAWNER_A, SPAWNER_B          = nil, nil

    local function ensureRefs()
        if not Remote then
            local RS = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            Remote = RS and RS:FindFirstChild("InteractWithItem")
        end
        if not Buttons then
            local PI = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Prison_ITEMS")
            Buttons = PI and PI:FindFirstChild("buttons")
        end
        if not CarContainer then
            CarContainer = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
        end
        return Remote and Buttons and CarContainer
    end

    local function getHRP()
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function closestCarSpawner()
        local hrp = getHRP()
        if not hrp or not Buttons then return nil end

        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, d in ipairs(Buttons:GetDescendants()) do
            if d.Name == "Car Spawner" and d:IsA("BasePart") then
                local dist = (d.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < bestDist then
                    best, bestDist = d, dist
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local function getSpawnerByIndex(i)
        if not Buttons then return nil end
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            local holder = Buttons:GetChildren()[i]
            return holder and holder:FindFirstChild("Car Spawner")
        end)
        return ok and result or nil
    end

    local function refreshSpawners()
        SPAWNER_A = getSpawnerByIndex(CONFIG.BUTTON_INDEX_A) or SPAWNER_A
        SPAWNER_B = getSpawnerByIndex(CONFIG.BUTTON_INDEX_B) or SPAWNER_B
    end

    local function fireSpawner(spawner)
        if not spawner or not Remote then return end
        pcall(function() Remote:InvokeServer(spawner) end)
    end

    local function trackCar(model)
        table.insert(carPool, { model = model, born = os.clock() })
