    end

    local function maintainPool()
        if not carPoolRunning then return end

        local now = os.clock()

        for i = #carPool, 1, -1 do
            local entry = carPool[i]
            if not entry.model or not entry.model.Parent then
                table.remove(carPool, i)
            end
        end

        if not LoopActive then return end

        for i = #carPool, 1, -1 do
            local entry = carPool[i]
            if entry.model and entry.model.Parent
                and now - entry.born >= CONFIG.CAR_LIFETIME then
                pcall(function() entry.model:Destroy() end)
                table.remove(carPool, i)
            end
        end

        while #carPool > CONFIG.MAX_CARS do
            local oldest = table.remove(carPool, 1)
            if oldest.model and oldest.model.Parent then
                pcall(function() oldest.model:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function startCarPool()
        if carPoolRunning then return end
        carPoolRunning = true

        carPoolThread = task.spawn(function()
            while carPoolRunning and not ensureRefs() do
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
            if not carPoolRunning then return end

            carPoolConn = CarContainer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if carPoolRunning and child:IsA("Model") then
                    trackCar(child)
                end
            end)

            while carPoolRunning do
                maintainPool()
                task.wait(0.1)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function stopCarPool()
        if not carPoolRunning then return end
        carPoolRunning = false

        if carPoolConn then
            carPoolConn:Disconnect()
            carPoolConn = nil
        end
        if carPoolThread then
            pcall(task.cancel, carPoolThread)
            carPoolThread = nil
        end

        for _, entry in ipairs(carPool) do
            if entry.model and entry.model.Parent then
                pcall(function() entry.model:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        carPool = {}
    end

    local function applyExploit(seat, targetRoot)
        seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(10000, 10000, 0)
        seat.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetRoot.Position) * CFrame.new(-2, 0, -12)
        pcall(sethiddenproperty, seat, "PhysicsRepRootPart", targetRoot)
        pcall(sethiddenproperty, seat, "PhysicsRepRootRef", InstanceHandle.new(targetRoot))

        local carModel = seat.Parent and seat.Parent.Parent
        local wheels   = carModel and carModel:FindFirstChild("Wheels")
        if wheels then wheels:Destroy() end
    end

    local function onOscStep()
        if not Enabled or not LoopActive or not CONFIG.OSCILLATE then return end
        local hrp = getHRP()
        if not hrp then return end

        local elapsed = os.clock() - oscStart
        local phase   = (elapsed % CONFIG.OSC_PERIOD) / CONFIG.OSC_PERIOD
        local tri     = phase < 0.5 and (phase * 2) or (2 - phase * 2)
        local t       = (1 - math.cos(tri * math.pi)) * 0.5
        local pos     = CONFIG.POS_A:Lerp(CONFIG.POS_B, t)

        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        local endpoint
        if tri < 0.05 then
            endpoint = "A"
        elseif tri > 0.95 then
            endpoint = "B"
        end

        if endpoint and endpoint ~= lastEnd then
            lastEnd = endpoint
            if endpoint == "A" then
                fireSpawner(SPAWNER_A)
            else
                fireSpawner(SPAWNER_B)
            end
        end
    end

    local function startOscillation()
        if oscConnection then return end
        refreshSpawners()
        oscStart      = os.clock()
        lastEnd       = nil
        oscConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(onOscStep)
    end

    local function stopOscillation()
        if oscConnection then
            oscConnection:Disconnect()
            oscConnection = nil
        end
        lastEnd = nil
    end

    local function spawnCar()
        local hrp = getHRP()
        if not hrp then return false end
        local button = closestCarSpawner()
        if not button then return false end

        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.Anchored = true
        hrp.CFrame   = CFrame.new(button.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        task.wait(0.1)
        hrp.Anchored = false
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        pcall(function() Remote:InvokeServer(button) end)
        return true
    end

    local function fireNotifier(message)
        if not Notifier then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(Notifier, message)
        end)
    end

    local function parseKickedName(msg)
        local spacePos = msg:find(" ")
        if spacePos then
            return msg:sub(1, spacePos - 1)
        end
        return msg
    end

    local function setupKickListener()
        if msgConn then return end

        local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        if not Remotes then return end
        local MessageReceived = Remotes:FindFirstChild("MessageReceived")
        if not MessageReceived then return end

        msgConn = MessageReceived.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(msg)
            if type(msg) ~= "string" then return end
            if not msg:find("kicked") then return end
            if not TargetName then return end

            local kickedName = parseKickedName(msg)
            if kickedName == "" then return end

            local target = Players:FindFirstChild(TargetName)
            if target then
                if kickedName == target.Name or kickedName == target.DisplayName then
                    pendingKicked = target.DisplayName
                end
            else
                if kickedName == TargetName or kickedName == TargetDisplay then
                    pendingKicked = TargetDisplay or TargetName
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function teardownKickListener()
        if msgConn then
            msgConn:Disconnect()
            msgConn = nil
        end
        pendingKicked = nil
    end

    local function mainLoop()
        lastSpawn = 0

        while Enabled and LoopActive do
            if not TargetName then break end

            local target = Players:FindFirstChild(TargetName)

            if not target then
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while os.clock() - t0 < CONFIG.KICK_WAIT and not pendingKicked do
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end

                if pendingKicked then
                    fireNotifier("Successfully kicked " .. pendingKicked .. "!")
                    pendingKicked = nil
                else
                    fireNotifier("Target left. Choose a new one.")
                end

                TargetName  = nil
                TargetDisplay = nil
                break
            end

            local tChar = target.Character
            local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local tHum  = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if tHum and tHum.Health <= 0 then
                if not targetDeathNotified then
                    targetDeathNotified = true
                    fireNotifier("Your target was killed, the fling is working..")
                end
            else
                targetDeathNotified = false
            end

            if not tRoot or not tRoot.Parent then
                task.wait(0.2)
            else
                if not CONFIG.OSCILLATE and (os.clock() - lastSpawn > 0.5) then
                    spawnCar()
                    lastSpawn = os.clock()
                end

                for _, entry in ipairs(carPool) do
                    local model = entry.model
                    if model and model.Parent then
                        for _, s in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                            if s:IsA("VehicleSeat") and isnetworkowner(s) then
                                pcall(applyExploit, s, tRoot)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait()
            end
        end

        LoopActive = false
        stopOscillation()
    end

    local function startLoop()
        if LoopActive then return end
        if not TargetName then return end
        if not ensureRefs() then return end

        LoopActive = true
        startOscillation()

        Thread = task.spawn(function()
            local ok, err = pcall(mainLoop)
            if not ok then
                warn("[VehicleFling] " .. tostring(err))
            end
            LoopActive = false
            stopOscillation()
        end)
    end

    local function stopLoop()
        LoopActive = false
        stopOscillation()
        if Thread then
            pcall(task.cancel, Thread)
            Thread = nil
        end
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled = true
        startCarPool()
        setupKickListener()
        if TargetName then
            startLoop()
        end
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false
        stopLoop()
        stopCarPool()
        teardownKickListener()
        targetDeathNotified = false
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
        SetTarget = function(player)
            if player == nil then
                TargetName          = nil
                TargetDisplay       = nil
                pendingKicked       = nil
                targetDeathNotified = false
                stopLoop()
                return
            end

            local newName, newDisplay
            if typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") then
                newName    = player.Name
                newDisplay = player.DisplayName
            elseif type(player) == "string" then
                newName    = player
                newDisplay = player
            else
                return
            end

            if newName == TargetName then return end

            TargetName          = newName
            TargetDisplay       = newDisplay
            pendingKicked       = nil
            targetDeathNotified = false

            if Enabled then
                stopLoop()
                startLoop()
            end
        end,
        GetTarget = function() return TargetName end,
        SetNotifier = function(fn) Notifier = fn end,
    }
end)()

return {
    VehicleFling = VehicleFling,
}
end)()

__bundle["AutoCriminal"] = (function()
local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace         = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local AutoCriminal = (function()
    local DELAY = 4

    local Enabled         = false
    local teleportPending = false
    local ArrestedConn    = nil

    local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
    local ClientArrested = Remotes and Remotes:WaitForChild("ClientArrested", 10)

    if not ClientArrested then
        warn("Parallax: please report this in the Discord.")
    end

    local spawnLocation
    do
        local spawnObj = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Criminals Spawn")
        spawnLocation = spawnObj and spawnObj:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation")
        if not spawnLocation then
            warn("Parallax: please report this issue in the Discord.")
        end
    end

    local function resolveSpawn()
        if spawnLocation and spawnLocation.Parent then return spawnLocation end

        local spawnObj = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Criminals Spawn")
        spawnLocation = spawnObj and spawnObj:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation")
        return spawnLocation
    end

    local function teleportToCriminalsSpawn()
        teleportPending = false

        if not Enabled then return end

        local spawn = resolveSpawn()
        if not spawn then return end

        task.wait(0.1)

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then
            LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
            char = LocalPlayer.Character
            task.wait(0.1)
        end

        if not Enabled then return end

        local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not rootPart then return end

        pcall(function()
            rootPart.CFrame       = spawn.CFrame
            rootPart.Velocity     = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            rootPart.RotVelocity  = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end)
    end

    local function onArrested()
        if not Enabled then return end
        if teleportPending then return end

        teleportPending = true
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(DELAY)
            teleportToCriminalsSpawn()
        end)
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        if not ClientArrested then return end
        Enabled = true
        ArrestedConn = ClientArrested.OnClientEvent:Connect(onArrested)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled = false
        teleportPending = false

        if ArrestedConn then
            ArrestedConn:Disconnect()
            ArrestedConn = nil
        end
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,
    }
end)()

return { AutoCriminal = AutoCriminal }
end)()

__bundle["Teleporter"] = (function()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Teleporter = (function()
    local LOCATIONS = {
        { Name = "Yard",            Group = "Prison",   Position = Vector3.new(780,       98,     2470)    },
        { Name = "Prison Interior", Group = "Prison",   Position = Vector3.new(913,       100,    2388)    },
        { Name = "Armory",          Group = "Prison",   Position = Vector3.new(831,       100,    2233)    },
        { Name = "Cafeteria",       Group = "Prison",   Position = Vector3.new(905,       100,    2316)    },
        { Name = "Criminal Base",   Group = "Criminal", Position = Vector3.new(-931,      94,     2063)    },
        { Name = "Mansion",         Group = "Outside",  Position = Vector3.new(-317.908,  64.572, 1841.095)},
        { Name = "Hideout",         Group = "Outside",  Position = Vector3.new(-304.232,  10.840, 884.459) },
        { Name = "Neutral Spawn",   Group = "Prison",   Position = Vector3.new(886.599,   39.590, 2353.903)},
    }

    local function teleport(position)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return false end

        local ok = pcall(function()
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
        end)
        return ok
    end

    return {
        Teleport = teleport,

        GetLocations = function()
            local out = {}
            for i, loc in ipairs(LOCATIONS) do
                out[i] = loc
            end
            return out
        end,
    }
end)()

return { Teleporter = Teleporter }
end)()

__bundle["FastRespawn"] = (function()
local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService        = game:GetService("RunService")
local Teams             = game:GetService("Teams")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local FastRespawn = (function()
    local DEATH_WINDOW   = 10
    local HIDE_FRAMES    = 3
    local FIGHT_TIME     = 0.1
    local FIRE_INTERVAL  = 0.05
    local TEAMS_POSITION = 1

    local Enabled         = false
    local lastAliveCFrame = nil
    local lastAliveTime   = 0
    local diedFired       = false

    local neutralSpawnGuard = true
    local wasOnTeamsMenu    = false

    local HeartbeatConn      = nil
    local CharacterAddedConn = nil
    local HumanoidConns      = {}

    local savedCFrameProvider = function() return nil end

    local function getSavedCFrame()
        local ok, result = pcall(savedCFrameProvider)
        if ok and typeof(result) == "CFrame" then return result end
        return nil
    end

    local teamsMenuReady = false
    local teamsMenuCheck = function() return false end

    task.spawn(function()
        local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 60)
        if not PlayerGui then return end

        local HomeGui = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("Home", 60)
        if not HomeGui then return end

        local IntroFrame = HomeGui:WaitForChild("IntroFrame", 30)
        if not IntroFrame then return end

        local ContentBackground = IntroFrame:WaitForChild("ContentBackground", 30)
        if not ContentBackground then return end

        local MainMenuFrame = ContentBackground:WaitForChild("MainMenuFrame", 30)
        if not MainMenuFrame then return end

        local TeamsFrame = MainMenuFrame:WaitForChild("TeamsFrame", 30)
        if not TeamsFrame then return end

        local MenuNavigation
        pcall(function()
            MenuNavigation = require(
                ReplicatedStorage.Scripts.UIController.Intro.MenuNavigation
            )
        end)

        teamsMenuCheck = function()
            if not IntroFrame.Visible then
                return false
            end
            if MenuNavigation and MenuNavigation.getCurrentPosition then
                local ok, pos = pcall(MenuNavigation.getCurrentPosition)
                if ok and pos ~= nil then
                    return pos == TEAMS_POSITION
                end
            end
            return TeamsFrame.Visible
        end

        teamsMenuReady = true
    end)

    local function isOnTeamsMenu()
        return teamsMenuReady and teamsMenuCheck()
    end

    local RequestTeamChange
    do
        local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        RequestTeamChange = Remotes and Remotes:WaitForChild("RequestTeamChange", 10)
    end

    local function fireTeamChange(team)
        if not RequestTeamChange then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                RequestTeamChange:InvokeServer(team, 1)
            end)
        end)
    end

    local function switchUntil(team, timeout)
        timeout = timeout or 5
        local deadline = tick() + timeout
        local nextFire = 0

        while tick() < deadline do
            if not Enabled then return LocalPlayer.Team == team end
            if LocalPlayer.Team == team then return true end

            local now = tick()
            if now >= nextFire then
                fireTeamChange(team)
                nextFire = now + FIRE_INTERVAL
            end
            task.wait()
        end
        return LocalPlayer.Team == team
    end

    local function onDied()
        if not Enabled then return end
        if diedFired then return end
        diedFired = true

        local snapshot = lastAliveCFrame
        if not snapshot then return end
        local originalTeam = LocalPlayer.Team or Teams.Neutral

        task.spawn(function()
            if not switchUntil(Teams.Neutral, 3) then
                warn("[Parallax] Fast Respawn: failed to reach Neutral")
                return
            end
            if not Enabled then return end
            if not switchUntil(originalTeam, 6) then
                warn("[Parallax] Fast Respawn: failed to rejoin " .. originalTeam.Name)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function teleportSeamless(character, root, target)
        local hidden = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                hidden[d] = d.LocalTransparencyModifier
                d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
            end
        end
        local addedConn = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                hidden[d] = d.LocalTransparencyModifier
                d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
            end
        end)

        root.CFrame = target
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        for _ = 1, HIDE_FRAMES do
            root.CFrame = target
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
        end

        for part, orig in pairs(hidden) do
            if part.Parent then
                part.LocalTransparencyModifier = orig
            end
        end
        addedConn:Disconnect()

        local deadline = tick() + FIGHT_TIME
        while tick() < deadline do
            if root.Parent then
                root.CFrame = target
            end
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
        end
    end

    local function clearHumanoidConns()
        for _, c in ipairs(HumanoidConns) do
            pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
        end
        HumanoidConns = {}
    end

    local function bindHumanoid(character)
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        if not humanoid then return end
        table.insert(HumanoidConns, humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
            if h <= 0 then onDied() end
        end))
        table.insert(HumanoidConns, humanoid.Died:Connect(onDied))
    end

    local function onCharacterAdded(character)
        diedFired = false

        bindHumanoid(character)

        local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        if not root then return end

        if lastAliveCFrame and (tick() - lastAliveTime) < DEATH_WINDOW then
            local target = lastAliveCFrame
            task.spawn(teleportSeamless, character, root, target)
        end
    end

    local function enable()
        if Enabled then return end
        Enabled        = true
        diedFired      = false
        wasOnTeamsMenu = false

        HeartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not (hum and root and hum.Health > 0) then return end

            if neutralSpawnGuard then
                if isOnTeamsMenu() then
                    lastAliveCFrame = nil
                    lastAliveTime   = 0
                    wasOnTeamsMenu  = true
                    return
                end

                if wasOnTeamsMenu then
                    wasOnTeamsMenu    = false
                    neutralSpawnGuard = false
                    lastAliveCFrame   = nil
                    lastAliveTime     = 0
                    return
                end
            end

            local saved = getSavedCFrame()
            lastAliveCFrame = saved or root.CFrame
            lastAliveTime   = tick()
        end)

        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            onCharacterAdded(LocalPlayer.Character)
        end

        CharacterAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            clearHumanoidConns()
            onCharacterAdded(char)
        end)
    end

    local function disable()
        if not Enabled then return end
        Enabled        = false
        diedFired      = false
        wasOnTeamsMenu = false

        if HeartbeatConn then
            HeartbeatConn:Disconnect()
            HeartbeatConn = nil
        end
        if CharacterAddedConn then
            CharacterAddedConn:Disconnect()
            CharacterAddedConn = nil
        end

        clearHumanoidConns()
        lastAliveCFrame = nil
        lastAliveTime   = 0
    end

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            if v == true then enable() else disable() end
            return Enabled
        end,
        Get = function() return Enabled end,

        SetSavedCFrameProvider = function(fn)
            if type(fn) == "function" then
                savedCFrameProvider = fn
            else
                savedCFrameProvider = function() return nil end
            end
        end,
    }
end)()

return { FastRespawn = FastRespawn }
end)()

return __bundle

end
